We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0a7dd7275d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

EPIC MELTDOWN: IL GOP Vice Chair Mark Shaw Pens Unhinged Rant, Calls Grassroots "Uninformed Lemmings" as Dele-Gate Scandal Intensifies (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/epic-meltdown-il-gop-vice-chair-mark-shaw-pens-unhinged-rant-calls-grassroots-uninformed-lemmings-as-dele-gate-scandal-intensifies.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0a7dd7275d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

By Illinois Review
On Saturday, embattled Illinois Republican Party Vice Chairman, former Trump Campaign Advisor and State Central Committee member Mark Shaw penned an angry, 10-page manifesto where he appeared unhinged as the IL GOP leader attempted to defend himself after it was revealed that he broke party rules and purposefully misrepresented himself as a delegate during the state convention last month.

In his 10-page meltdown, Shaw was in attack mode, angrily attacking fellow SSC members, county GOP leaders, the grassroots – which he referred to as “uniformed lemmings,” and he even borrowed a line from Democrat Gov. JB Pritzker – calling former GOP attorney general nominee Tom DeVore a “grifter.” In October 2021, Gov. Pritzker called DeVore a
“grifter” for filing lawsuits against the governor’s mask mandate in schools during the pandemic.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/epic-meltdown-il-gop-vice-chair-mark-shaw-pens-unhinged-rant-calls-grassroots-uninformed-lemmings-as-dele-gate-scandal-intensifies.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0a7dd7275d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

The embattled state party leader, who’s actions continue to embarrass Republicans statewide, also took personal shots at Lake County GOP Central Committee Chairman Keith Brin and fellow SSC members Sean Morrison and Aaron Del Mar – turning a letter that was supposed to be a defense of his actions into a script for the Jerry Springer Show. The petty and epic 10-page meltdown sounded more like a childish rant – and not something you’d expect from a senior member of the Illinois Republican Party.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/epic-meltdown-il-gop-vice-chair-mark-shaw-pens-unhinged-rant-calls-grassroots-uninformed-lemmings-as-dele-gate-scandal-intensifies.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0a7dd7275d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
The IL GOP Vice Chair also suggested censuring this publication and its owners, writing, “What censure exists for those who seek to advance their own ‘careers’ at the expense of party unity...” Such censorship is common among Democrats and countries like Brazil, China and Russia, where opposing political voices and reporters are silenced. But this isn’t the first time this has been proposed. Last year, SSC member Jeanne Ives suggested censoring this publication after appearing agitated by stories covering the IL GOP and some of it’s leadership including IL GOP Chairman Don Tracy.

David McCormick, if elected, will only further sow division. McCormick is wrong for Pennsylvania and wrong for this country. With fundamental rights on the line this November, we can’t take anything for granted. That means we must put everything on the table over the next six months to re-elect Bob Casey. We need your support to get there. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_061624_fathersday [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_061624_fathersday]
Hi Peter, it’s nice to meet you! I’m Errol, Cori’s dad.
First off, I want to wish all the dads, grandfathers, pa-pas, and father figures in our movement a Happy Father’s Day.
Being a father has been the greatest privilege in my life. Watching Cori transform our politics and deliver real change to St. Louis fills my heart with joy.
You see, Cori always swore up and down that politics wasn’t for someone like her. As a child, she watched me work long hours as a public servant and asked why anyone would ever volunteer for that. She saw the hatred and the nastiness that often accompanies politics.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_061624_fathersday [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_061624_fathersday]
But she also saw the impact you can truly have on people's lives. Ever since she was a little girl, Cori has made it her life’s mission to help others because she knows that, whether you’re an elected official or not, it is our duty to help people.
After Michael Brown was killed in 2014, I remember Cori was on the frontlines of the Ferguson Uprising for over 400 days, taking care of people and demanding accountability. My baby girl was following her calling by attending to our community, putting her love and compassion to work as a nurse and a pastor in the streets of Ferguson, just minutes from her childhood home. For her, this movement has never been about just one person, and it’s certainly not about her; it’s about justice and equality for ALL people.
I’m so proud of Cori and everything she’s accomplished during her time in Congress. She’s already recognized as a key leader in the movement for racial and social justice, and I know that there’s so much more she’s ready to tackle.
But first, we need to have Cori’s back in her competitive primary this August. Between me and you, all I want this Father’s Day is to see my daughter win – because she’s advancing our movement in the Halls of Congress.
Can I count on you to support my daughter’s re-election campaign by donating what you can today? I can’t express my appreciation enough for you all. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_061624_fathersday]

Look,

Last week, we sent you an urgent poll about Social Security after a new House Republican plan called for over $1.5 trillion in cuts to Social Security, including an increase in the retirement age to 69 and cutting disability benefits.

name: Dawn Moore
subject: Happy Father’s Day!
body:
Friend,
Happy Father’s Day!
Today, I want to celebrate all the fathers across the country, especially those in Maryland, and of course, my husband, Wes.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90457/images/IMG_0466.jpg]

Not only is Wes the best husband, but seeing how he shows up for our kids every day truly warms my heart.

Even with a busy schedule, and the long hours he puts in on behalf of all Marylanders, Wes still makes the time to show up for the moments that truly matter for our family. He plays football with the kids in the front yard, he shows up for their school events, and we hold Saturday night dinners sacred.

Today, I hope you’ll take the time to sign our card for Wes. Every message he receives from this team means the world to Wes, and I want to show him extra appreciation for all that he does for our family, and for families across Maryland. [https://support.wesmoore.com/a/fathers-day-card-2024-1?source=20240616-1]

Sign the card » [https://support.wesmoore.com/a/fathers-day-card-2024-1?source=20240616-1]

Thank you for celebrating Wes, and all fathers today.

Dawn Moore
First Lady of Maryland

subject: Sunday News Digest: 6/16/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**June 16, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Hi Readers,
First of all, happy Father's day to all the dad's out there. My love for politics started first from my dad and granddads' passion for country. So it felt right that I spent the weekend with my freedom-loving father at several RMV events fighting to save America! And today, we had a big BBQ to celebrate the BBQ-king himself, my hubby Jason. Hope you all have a fantastic day and thank you to all the wonderful father's out there.

This week, Rocky Mountain Voice took a deep dive into the **primary races** heating up across Colorado, providing a comprehensive overview of the contested seats up for grabs. Here's a quick recap of the highlights from our special series:
* **Intense[District Attorney](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Contests:** Three district attorney positions saw significant competition, notably in the [newly formed 23rd District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The focus was not only on the candidates' platforms but also on the broader implications for local law enforcement and community safety.
* **Colorado[House](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [Senate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Races:** With the Democrats holding a substantial majority in the Colorado House, the series spotlighted the [18 House races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with primary opposition. Similarly, the Senate races, where Democrats are a [single seat away from a supermajority](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), were closely examined to understand the potential shifts in legislative power.
* **[Board of Regents](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [State Board of Education](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.):** Unique insights were provided into the [single opposed race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the University of Colorado Board of Regents and the [two opposed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) State Board of Education races, discussing how these roles influence educational policy and governance at state and local levels.
* **[U.S. Representative](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Races:** Coverage included an overview of the contests for U.S. Representative, particularly the crowded races in the [3rd and 4th districts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), highlighting the strategic moves of incumbents and newcomers alike.

Each article in the series not only outlined who was running and their political platforms but also featured voter concerns and the broader political landscape influencing these races. As Coloradans head to the polls, Rocky Mountain Voice remains committed to delivering detailed and unbiased coverage of the state's dynamic political scene.
\---
**Voting Information:**
* **Primary Election Day:** Tuesday, June 25.
* Coloradans can register to vote at [GoVoteColorado.gov](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) through June 17 to receive a mailed ballot. Additionally, registration can be completed in person at a voting center until 7 p.m. on Election Day.
* Registered voters should have received or will soon receive their mailed ballots. You can track your ballot at [BallotTrax.coloradosos.gov](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

Have a great week ahead,
Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **STATE**
---
**[U.S Attorney's Office in Colorado investigating dozens of fake COVID-19 claims, worth roughly $75 million](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The United States Attorney's Office for the District of Colorado (USACO) is investigating dozens of COVID-19 fraud cases, worth roughly $75 million.

**[Wolves in Colorado can be hunted under specific conditions, says wildlife commission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A divided Colorado Parks and Wildlife commission on Thursday voted to allow for the lethal management of wolves under certain situations, a move that ranchers in Grand and Jackson counties have sought for months.
**[Has your water bill gone up? Some Coloradans have seen increases up to 600%](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) It's time to take a second look at that monthly water bill: For some Coloradans, the cost of turning on the tap has been rising for decades, and experts say it is primed to keep climbing.
**[Eight gun-control bills were passed by Colorado's legislature and signed by the governor. Here's a look.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Gov. Jared Polis signed into law eight bills passed by the legislature this year that tighten Colorado's gun statutes.

_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[Tucker Carlson tour to stop Sept. 6 in Colorado Springs with Tulsi Gabbard](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Tucker Carlson, the former Fox News conservative primetime show host, will make Colorado Springs a destination this fall. Following stops in Phoenix, Ariz., and Anaheim, Calif., to open the Tucker Carlson Live Tour, Carlson will visit Colorado Springs on Sept. 6 at the Broadmoor World Arena.
**[Hunter Biden found guilty on all counts by Delaware jury in gun trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A federal jury convicted Hunter Biden Tuesday of three felony counts stemming from the purchase of a gun in October 2018 while in the throes of a crack addiction, making him the first child of a sitting president to be convicted of a crime.
**[Supreme Court strikes down Trump-era ban on bump stocks, gun accessories used in 2017 massacre](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The Supreme Court on Friday struck down a Trump-era ban on bump stocks, a gun accessory that allows semi-automatic weapons to fire rapidly like machine guns and was used in the deadliest mass shooting in modern U.S. history.
**[Fed holds interest rates at 23-year high as inflation hits plateau](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The Federal Reserve held interest rates at a 23-year high Wednesday as its battle to bring down inflation drags deeper into 2024. The announcement follows a two-day meeting of the central bank's monetary policy committee, which raised borrowing rates from near zero in March 2022 to a range of 5.25 percent to 5.5 percent as pandemic-induced inflation skyrocketed.
**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Superior passes first-of-it-kind resolution condemning anti-Israeli protesters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) An anti-Israeli protest outside a private residence has prompted the town of Superior to take unprecedented action. Town trustees -- including one who is married to a Palestinian -- unanimously passed a resolution condemning protesters for "hate speech, antisemitism, and racism" against Jewish people.
**[Arapahoe County weighing cuts in face of budget shortfall, absent of new funding](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CENTENNIAL CITIZEN-INDEPENDENT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Arapahoe County's annual State of the County address had two elements. On one hand, leaders celebrated the various services the county government provides to residents. On the other hand, leaders said some of those services are imperiled.
**[Denver Public Schools to consider asking taxpayers for nearly $1 billion bond](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) School may be out right now, but dozens of Denver schools need major improvements. Denver Public Schools is looking to ask voters for nearly $1 billion -- it's largest ever -- in the form of a bond.
**[Monument places town manager on leave in'best interests of community'](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Monument town manager Mike Foreman is on paid administrative leave after a special Town Council meeting Wednesday. The Town Council told Foreman, who has been with the town since 2019, that the days until a review meeting on June 25 would allow time for him to address concerns from councilmembers about his performance. The nature of the review was not made public.

_**[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Gaines: My experience with wolves, Gov. Polis and the legal system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _We have finally approached the end of our settlement. I won 't go into the gory details (if you want more, I linked to Rachel Gabel's contemporaneous op ed below), but back in January of this year, I testified at a Colorado Parks and Wildlife commissioners meeting. I was quite critical of the way that they handled their business._
__
**[Cooper: Is signature verification of mail-in ballots valid?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _All mail-in voting systems use a process called signature verification to verify the person voting by mail is the voter registered to vote. In Colorado this process is based on comparing the signature on the outer ballot envelope with the digital signature images in a database called SCORE._
**[Walcher: The EPA's end run around the Supreme Court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [GREGWALCHER.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _An "end run" was once a common football term, describing an offensive play in which the ball carrier runs around the end of the defensive line. But today it is more often used rhetorically to describe a strategic dodge, any maneuver to bypass, circumvent, or sidestep. It's more common in politics than in football._
**[Krannawitter: Campaign finance reform is to blame for prosecution of Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [LIBERTY LYCEUM SUBSTACK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Campaign finance laws --not merely McCain-Feingold--were at the heart of the recent jury conviction of Donald Trump. A more accurate title, therefore, could be: Revenge of Campaign Finance Reform Laws._
**[Prager: Why Americans mistrust election results more than the citizens of any other democracy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [TOWN HALL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Last week, 27 European nations voted for their representatives in the European Parliament. If you were aware of this, did you happen to notice that there were no allegations of cheating in any European country? If you are on the left, you might respond that there were no such allegations because the right did better than the left, and it 's the right that makes these allegations._ __
_**[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming a RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
|
---
**🤔 DID YOU KNOW?** It took until 1966 for President Lyndon Johnson to make a nationwide proclamation **endorsing Father 's Day** across the country. In his proclamation, Johnson wrote that on June 19, 1966, "I invite State and local governments to cooperate in the observance of that day; and I urge all our people to give public and private expression to the love and gratitude which they bear for their fathers."

Nowhere in Johnson's proclamation did it say anything about what would happen on Father's Day the next year, though, and the corresponding Joint Resolution specified "the third Sunday in June of 1966." It wasn't until President Richard Nixon signed Public Law 92-278 that Father's Day was permanently recognized by the federal government.

In his proclamation, Johnson wrote that on June 19, 1966, "I invite State and local governments to cooperate in the observance of that day; and I urge all our people to give public and private expression to the love and gratitude which they bear for their fathers." Nowhere in Johnson's proclamation did it say anything about what would happen on Father's Day the next year, though, and the corresponding Joint Resolution specified "the third Sunday in June of 1966." I hope you'll read this entire message, then consider splitting a donation between my campaign and the California Democratic Party to help us improve lives in CA-27 and beyond. When I think about why I'm running for Congress, I think about my kids -- specifically my daughter, Maya.

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbhpnblmhtn7a22e9p6f78coeps8ju1ps2riae50_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdi66or2cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqgiv1vgsl8f22ddu0bh3cisuu3033ondo4l1b68_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdi66or2cjh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2lc270fbinspechnb34v9a24dgnbr45nm086dco_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdi66or2cjh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zuflrishee9vbqhoa7ia6milb111ebi87tocgggo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdh6co76c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zf4pvn63shpronfneu1h6416405t5tvemtqi79g0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdh62pr2cph2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsjtdq75irpvo0j6c6o81tdjd29bgku5mqmlbd18_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdh62pr2cph2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjpcfloe4i59draqjhgeu3k9dicrv1oivim6a9qg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdh62pr2cph2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. | | **Youngkin Letter Prompts Biden Commitment to Protect Pentagon from CCP Solar Panels ** **ICYMI:** Just days after Governor Glenn Youngkin expressed security concerns over President Biden's plan to install solar panels on the roof of the Pentagon, the Biden Administration is now promising that those solar panels will not be sourced from China.

[According to Fox News](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e1ba0544b04113353cc2e027c3af66a1fa7f5a2dcdc0959dd0682b9511b5bae48699edf6c10914560ba1073ccf003d2b0b72c0d43d20c0439c1c0da8d66a6a98 "According to Fox News"), the Biden Administration's response "came after Virginia Gov. Glenn Youngkin penned a letter to Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin last week expressing concerns that a $104 million, taxpayer-funded plan to add solar panels to the Pentagon and other installations would make use of Chinese materials, which the governor warned would have 'significant implications for U.S. national security.'"

Following [Youngkin's letter](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e1ba0544b0411335e4366ff949330b4422a58da82b4f70f9868d75df6aed1f38dc0c09dcb2b15e51a4af403983044eb2982c5fc198191e07577c637d0c045b70 "Youngkin’s letter"), the Biden Administration made a commitment to address the concerns made by Governor Youngin.

"The DOD will not be installing Chinese-manufactured solar panels on the Pentagon," the Pentagon told Fox News.

As Fox reported, "a spokesperson for Youngkin's office welcomed the news, saying the governor is 'pleased that Secretary Austin will follow his recommendations to adopt the 'Made in America' requirements for procuring Chinese solar panels.'"

This comes as Youngkin remains a leader among America's governors in confronting potential threats from the Chinese Communist Party (CCP)

Youngkin halted a Chinese battery company from coming to Virginia, [citing concerns](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e1ba0544b041133535d1a1d227358340fbdc5f0aa9cb713ace33bfa26ee80ed0a486435ef9f4054585c569ec84983b089b78f6eb241ee24d3eb4ae2f84648881 "citing concerns") it would serve as a "Trojan horse" for the CCP.

Youngkin's decision was [followed by Congress](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e1ba0544b04113359c1b5c75b0fbfab2669b9119ecfbc8bc0596c6aea2287dc674c5729d60edcef57083ad328f9f0a791e43bd0e1ec668650e0242ce24961e5a "followed by Congress") banning the Pentagon from purchasing batteries from that very same company.

As Senator Glen Sturtevant wrote in a [Richmond Times-Dispatch op-ed](https://click.go.spiritofvirginia.org/?qs=e1ba0544b0411335076cb66e2339653943b324bcdeccec2462b1ad1d29be84c57282286bbf886a5627d5e9b24feb03058af7ce7d4cc003a12714be00f2e111a3 "Richmond Times-Dispatch op-ed") last week, "when Gov. Youngkin decided to withdraw Virginia from being considered as the landing ground for the Ford-CATL factory, he did so with Virginia's best interests and the United States' national security in mind. While it took some time for the truth behind CATL to become more widely known, it is reassuring to see the governor, Congress and the Biden administration on the same page regarding a corporate pawn of the Chinese Communist Party."

clean_body: Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College - Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called " The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Dina Titus cannot run on her dismal record, so instead she is lying about me and my positions on issues. This is the same tactic she used during the last election. It is Titus who has done nothing in Congress to protect Social Security and Medicare from impending bankruptcy. During the last election, Titus made these, and even worse lies. My consultants told me to ignore them. They said she wants us talking about abortion to distract people from looking at the border, inflation, drugs, crime, the deteriorating condition of world affairs, and all of her, and Biden's, other failures. This time will be different. We will use every legal tool available to us to stop her from making false, malicious, and dishonest claims in her attempt to illegally influence an election. You can help us in this effort. It takes money to respond to Titus's lies and to get the truth out. You can join us to fight her dishonesty by making a contribution to our campaign. | | June 17, 2024 Over the last several weeks, Jim Himes on several occasions, in a joint [Press Release](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B1W68L3NRiA5rR82L2mbiwS5dYantgra7tO0vYWI9Hj9IwM4Obru-bnyOOocuyxGoVpPF4wYuG_X6gkTU-sju_jGO6okBMDAuQ_4R9N9_WOluFFLxUXsZI9-IJhu_bj0WHGD5Me1nONQGLyn9bsg2YlslcODd-gmcpr-3UMPMQ_20hDUA3M1rnmSYsmfxRW1Wz3OMjQ05rDerDUt3twFADZSO_wUazJp&c=pfFAbWCieZTFG6ovJd3OXgCqI-YQ6GPcVhVS0NYbI2qYuoosLCiEvg==&ch=WYpsB0JJZY6tEdjmRLeyZ4BCWUenhFqn_2KDwKrWw-JxcLAwwPjKvA==), [Public Statements](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B1W68L3NRiA5rR82L2mbiwS5dYantgra7tO0vYWI9Hj9IwM4Obru-bnyOOocuyxGoVpPF4wYuG_X6gkTU-sju_jGO6okBMDAuQ_4R9N9_WOluFFLxUXsZI9-IJhu_bj0WHGD5Me1nONQGLyn9bsg2YlslcODd-gmcpr-3UMPMQ_20hDUA3M1rnmSYsmfxRW1Wz3OMjQ05rDerDUt3twFADZSO_wUazJp&c=pfFAbWCieZTFG6ovJd3OXgCqI-YQ6GPcVhVS0NYbI2qYuoosLCiEvg==&ch=WYpsB0JJZY6tEdjmRLeyZ4BCWUenhFqn_2KDwKrWw-JxcLAwwPjKvA==) to the media, and in [X Postings](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B1W68L3NRiA5rR82L2mbiwS5dYantgra7tO0vYWI9Hj9IwM4Obru-bnyOOocuyxGB4Z4ciE0Iu2eB6Ea9_ReuqUozMIB2UjW7v8YKNiSimCIrF_EDTprtLxWGZlvDdllkIvQlt4WlIhnTZJA1VpvHdOCyK1Ra3SlvA969824hSO7NLAwTF2s7knrKt9YgsPrjrB7TtA1OjU=&c=pfFAbWCieZTFG6ovJd3OXgCqI-YQ6GPcVhVS0NYbI2qYuoosLCiEvg==&ch=WYpsB0JJZY6tEdjmRLeyZ4BCWUenhFqn_2KDwKrWw-JxcLAwwPjKvA==) has made it clear he supports and has urged the use of U.S. military assets by Ukraine's forces to strike targets within Russia. Over the past two years, the U.S. has supplied military assets to Ukraine to fight Russian forces inside Ukraine. There's been robust debate over the wisdom of our involvement, but the Russians are clearly the aggressors, and they are being fought within the sovereign territory of Ukraine. But it is stunning, and I would suggest reckless, for Mr. Himes to approve more advanced weaponry for Ukraine to target assets within the confines of Russia. It's remarkable how Mr. Himes breezily slides into a posture of approving the firing of U.S. weapons at Russia, and drawing the distinction that it is the Ukrainian personnel pulling the triggers. He's been gaslighting us that that distinction makes a consequential difference. Really??? The Russian military is staring at advanced U.S. weaponry trained on them, but operated by U.S.-trained Ukrainian soldiers. And Jim Himes thinks the Russians care who is taking the final action and pressing the launch button? Himes said "I think we should be moving the arms more rapidly, and yes, allowing the Ukrainians to use those arms to hit artillery, which is stationed in Russia." Message to Jim Himes - if the weapons are fired, the Russians may consider it an attack by the U.S. To make their assessment perfectly clear, in the past week the Russians sent an unmistakable warning to the United States, which was widely reported upon in all the U.S. media. The [Russians deployed a flotilla](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B1W68L3NRiA5rR82L2mbiwS5dYantgra7tO0vYWI9Hj9IwM4Obru-bnyOOocuyxGc11V9267iBiwZUv-wal0BFwKeqsRgAfkQi50XdjIjMBrp6yAPM-1-V8wcCM1DhhCtVJ07-DhZ9VJ48K-Cp2arsVKohO-sULmAtilBj_onhF0vU0xMF9bRYsi-8LHWSlBLkG7YXrtv-s9AzQB2IEjr_P7cqutw5FSxTQWoBHbEoorN9nzVtdykSRX2ZoTodQ8g0rc_9Zl8STh9qJnG3KzPZCORA3R-q2mKu-DnUeg9ZSM8_zND6VTp_Nj2c92tysT&c=pfFAbWCieZTFG6ovJd3OXgCqI-YQ6GPcVhVS0NYbI2qYuoosLCiEvg==&ch=WYpsB0JJZY6tEdjmRLeyZ4BCWUenhFqn_2KDwKrWw-JxcLAwwPjKvA==), including a frigate and a nuclear-powered submarine, which sailed within 30 miles of Key Largo on its way to Cuba. Most oxygen-breathing Americans got the message, but it's questionable whether Mr. Himes, the national security team, or the Pentagon can add two plus two anymore. The statement from the Pentagon spokeswoman was that the Russians deploy such assets from time to time, and it really wasn't out of the ordinary, "we've seen them do this -- these type of port calls before -- and these are routine naval visits that we've seen under different administrations...We're always constantly going to monitor any foreign vessels operating near U.S. territorial waters ... but these exercises don't pose a threat to the United States," she said. If Jim Himes and the Biden Administration actually believe this, they are gaslighting themselves, as well as the American people. The Russians are clearly signaling to us that if we allow our advanced weaponry to strike mother Russia, they are positioned to retaliate in kind. Does Mr. Himes really want to test that logical proposition?? The Biden Administration, with Mr. Himes' full-throated support are obsessed with the eastern border of Ukraine, to the point where they have now recklessly exposed the U.S. mainland to attack. These are not the statements and actions of a "Moderate."
Radical Jim Himes is NO Moderate
The 2024 election will be a referendum on Jim Himes' failed 15-year rule.

name: Mike Dugan
subject: Let’s set the record straight about a few things
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE DUGAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | |
---
Team, Election Day is tomorrow! Polls will be open from 7:00 am - 7:00 pm.

**[If you didn’t vote early, please find your polling location here and make your plan to vote well ahead of time.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/903ebf0e840aef0a3947229f28c3afba/1caa0e60646b9332c3d6b838967d376c/45443)**

Now, there are several more things I need to share with you.

**First, by now you may have seen an attack ad or two launched my way. **

**These DC special interest groups are nervous about the momentum we’ve built, and they’re determined to force their candidate into this seat. **

So, they’re spending hundreds of thousands (if not more) to influence this election and stretch the truth (at best) about my voting record.

**The fact is this** : Eight sheriffs in this district support me because they know I’m the candidate who will close the border, end the invasion of fentanyl into our communities, and give law enforcement the tools they need to keep communities safe.

**This is politics at its worst, and it’s happening because Brian Jack and his supporters have no answer for the very real differences between us in this campaign.**

**— > I’m an Army Ranger, successful business leader, and conservative Senator. **

Brian Jack is a career bureaucrat.

**— > I’ve written policy that became law, made tough decisions on tough votes, and come back home to explain why we did things the way we did.**

Brian Jack has sat in a room while others made those decisions.

**— > I live, work, raised my family, and go to church in the 3rd District.**

Brian Jack left it for California, and then DC, as soon as he could. He’s never paid property taxes here.

**— > The overwhelming majority of our support in this campaign has come from the 3rd District, and if not the 3rd then the State of Georgia.**

Almost all of Brian Jack’s support has come from everywhere but here.

**You can look at me, my record, and my life and know who I’m running to serve. You can’t say the same for Brian Jack. **

**And that’s why his special interest supporters are getting desperate.**

**So, what can we do between now and tomorrow?**

First, call or email your family, friends, neighbors, and colleagues to remind them there’s an election. **[**Find your polling location and make a plan to vote.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/903ebf0e840aef0a3947229f28c3afba/3c7fa8ce1790fa71c3d6b838967d376c/45443)**

Second, forward this email to anyone you know who has questions about the choice in this campaign.

**Third, show your support with a quick video. If you can, I hope you’ll record a quick, simple video about why you’re supporting Mike Dugan for Congress and send it to us as a response to this email.**

**[Here’s an example of one my daughter Meghan recorded yesterday.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/903ebf0e840aef0a3947229f28c3afba/a88883784cfec065c3d6b838967d376c/45443)**

**[And here’s one my son Beau recorded.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/903ebf0e840aef0a3947229f28c3afba/736f29dc448c40a9c3d6b838967d376c/45443)**

We’ve made this far because of YOU, and we’re leaving it all on the field before the polls close tomorrow at 7 pm. Let's go!
---
---
Mike DuganRepublican for Georgia's 3rd District
---
|
---
Emails like this one are one of the most important ways we keep supporters in the loop. We'd hate to see you go, but if [click here if you want to unsubscribe.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go.cfm?a=1&eid=8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292&c=45443&jid=903ebf0e840aef0a3947229f28c3afba&d=41568c29d9345361c3d6b838967d376c&u=http://ci.criticalimpact.com/procenter/procenter.cfm?action=profile&eid=8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292&c=45443&jid=903ebf0e840aef0a3947229f28c3afba)

Friend -
In my experience, very few people wake up in the morning with "donate to a political campaign" on their to-do list.
It may be something a bigwig writing a huge check has on their list, but for most folks that is just not the case.
But that is what I am going to ask you to do today. Right now, in fact. And here's why:
The media is reporting that the National Republican Senatorial Committee -- the main organization supporting Republicans running for Senate -- is spending "seven figures" to run an organizing campaign supporting Mike Rogers, one of my potential opponents.
That means they'll be setting up the structures that allow them to identify and turn out millions of his voters. It's a significant commitment and one that will result in more votes for him...and for Trump.
When we see something like this pop up, it alters the dynamic of the race in a way we have to respond to. It often means we need to raise a bit more money to counteract the Republicans because more voters for them means we need to find more votes for ourselves.
But unlike Mike Rogers, our campaign is funded by lots of people making individual donations -- many of which come in response to emails like this.
So while it may not have been on your mind when you woke up, I am asking:

| _Who are you partnered with?_ It’s no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms compare so you can decide on the fit for you.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z123fom73v372arjdidk12dtn1i2hkmg6i7tlg28_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdgm4pr2c3h2bs)

Ready to kickstart your retirement? Working with a financial advisor can be a crucial part of any healthy retirement plan. But with thousands of options available, knowing where to start can seem daunting. That’s why SmartAsset created a [no-cost tool](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zd32doj2n6cn48gt47in9atujha60rgh506verog_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdgm4pr2c3h2bs) to help match you with up to three financial advisors serving your area. All advisors on the platform are rigorously screened through a proprietary due diligence process and legally bound to work in your best interest.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor:
* feel more at ease about their finances
* could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1

It's never too late to plan to work toward a comfortable retirement.

[See how Vanguard, Fidelity and Schwab stack up »](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zqt463g0upd6d4qnch1faejjps1s06oi60vih62g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdgm4pr2c3h2bs)

Last week Hillary Clinton entered one of the most hotly contested Democratic primaries nationwide when she endorsed George Latimer over incumbent Democrat Jamaal Bowman in New York's 16th Congressional District. Tragically, as the receipts below show, Clinton's endorsement betrays Democratic principles and legitimizes bigotry, and we need to call it out so it does not become further normalized.
So, **Let 's Address This.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145652637&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1NjUyNjM3LCJpYXQiOjE3MTg2Mjk0NTcsImV4cCI6MTcyMTIyMTQ1NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.Es9ECK20aKgY9uy1ibhVRP_10jKT-9bKENwf_vSZb8k)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/827d79ce-bf38-43b0-a091-3816dc4fbbe9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Jamaal Bowman (L), Hillary Clinton (C), George Latimer (R). Collage Credit: Leigh Vogel, EUGENE GOLOGURSKY & TASOS KATOPODIS / GETTY IMAGES NORTH AMERICA / Getty Images via AFP
On June 12 Hillary Clinton [tweeted](https://substack.com/redirect/7a1569d1-8454-473e-ae50-ed55bbadd0ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> With Trump on the ballot, we need strong, principled Democrats in Congress more than ever. In Congress, [@LatimerforNY](https://substack.com/redirect/c6bd0dfe-7fbd-4619-b5a1-22aa9aa1618a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) will protect abortion rights, stand up to the NRA, and fight for President Biden's agenda--just like he's always done. Make a plan to vote by June 25th!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/657cd283-1502-4db5-bdf7-4cfa8e164326?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I responded by pointing out that Latimer is MAGA funded, and also that when I ran for Congress against a corporate funded Democrat in a deep blue seat, I was lectured endlessly that "we don't primary Dems because we need party unity." Why did party unity mantra suddenly go out the window? The immediate response to my tweet from some was quite aggressive, and I wondered if people either don't know, or don't care that Latimer is MAGA funded?
Because unfortunately, in addition to Latimer's extensive funding from right wing extremists, literally everything about Clinton's statement, positions, and implicit accusations against incumbent Jamal Bowman, is entirely false. Unlike Latimer, Bowman is not a career politician. He's one of the first Black men to represent Westchester in Congress, and one of only 62 Black members in all of U.S. Congress. With the NY-16 primary rapidly approaching on June 25, the race has sharply divided Democrats. Yet still, many [former Latimer supporters have started a group to openly support Congressman Bowman](https://substack.com/redirect/cde9e970-393a-4f82-9026-1e11d565654c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Let's dive into the receipts with three key reasons why Clinton's endorsement is so destructive (yes, destructive) to the Democratic Party and to our national politics.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..7V8Em-xVrP8FUj1J7nI5nOQ9P9iUZyELgVY8P5FLXz0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145652637)
1. **Yes, George Latimer is MAGA funded**

First, George Latimer is absolutely MAGA funded to the tune of millions of dollars. In fact, he's funded by the same right wing donors that helped Donald Trump defeat Hillary Clinton in 2016. As [Liza Featherstone wrote for Jacobin](https://substack.com/redirect/8b9828c8-c6ac-4563-b4b2-7b7bbd043bac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Louro, an insurance mogul who has already given $5,000 to Latimer, is a top Donald Trump fundraiser. He hosted a $5,000-a-plate event for Trump in 2016. In the last election, he hosted a party for New York governor Kathy Hochul's far-right opponent, Lee Zeldin. Donald Trump Jr. was a featured speaker. Louro...has also served as regional finance chairman for New York state's Republican Party. Alex Dubitsky, CEO of a "bespoke insurance" firm based in Connecticut, who gave $15,000 to Trump in 2020, held a brunch in January at his home in Larchmont, inviting his friends to pay up to $6,600 to meet and greet Latimer. Hedge funder Daniel Loeb has also donated to Latimer. Loeb is a charter school zealot who has given $1.5 million to Mitch McConnell, $200,000 to a PAC supporting Dr Oz, along with millions to the Republican Party.
And this is but the tip of the ice berg of the additional millions that AIPAC is spending to unseat Bowman due to his 'unforgivable' position of demanding an end to the siege on Gaza that has, to date, killed at least 37,000 Palestinian civilians. It is simply mind boggling that Clinton would endorse a candidate for Congress--against an incumbent Democrat no less--who is propped up by the same MAGA extremists that helped defeat her.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..7V8Em-xVrP8FUj1J7nI5nOQ9P9iUZyELgVY8P5FLXz0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145652637)
2. **Clinton 's stated reasons to endorse Latimer contradict themselves**

Next, Clinton's premise is she's endorsing Latimer because "Trump is on the ballot" -- which already doesn't make sense given Latimer's MAGA support. She continues that, "Latimer will protect abortion rights, stand up to the NRA, and fight for President Biden's agenda." But none of this makes sense either for the following reasons.
First, Bowman is staunchly pro access and [endorsed by Planned Parenthood](https://substack.com/redirect/6ed24e2c-39f4-4b28-9d00-25601d1103ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--so Latimer brings nothing new here. Second, Bowman is staunchly pro gun safety and anti-NRA and is [endorsed by the Brady Campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/00b3bc32-248f-4a0f-b329-dddedd701701?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) among other gun safety organizations--so again, Latimer brings nothing new here either.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/638a28fe-f18e-4315-91cc-dc66c13d2222?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Third, Jamaal Bowman has supported President Biden's economic policies to cancel student debt, ensure the wealthy pay their fair share in taxes, and has [voted with Biden more than 94% of the time](https://substack.com/redirect/b79f165c-4ec6-47ac-86b1-d39221ede638?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--while George Latimer is [on record that he is](https://substack.com/redirect/04e888a0-b863-40dd-9a47-34d3c11958ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _**** "not signing on to raising taxes" on the wealthy, as Mr_. _Biden wants_. So on abortion, gun safety, and Biden's economic agenda, Bowman is already a champion--while Latimer brings nothing new on abortion and guns, and instead is on record _opposing_ Biden's economic policies while aligning himself with Trump's economic policies.
In short, Clinton endorsed the candidate who wants to block President Biden's plan to raise taxes on billionaires and trillion dollar corporations, over the incumbent Democrat working _with_ President Biden on strengthening the middle class and holding the wealthy accountable--all at a time when wealth and income inequality is at record highs. This is the "strong principled Democrat" Hillary Clinton wants in Congress?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..7V8Em-xVrP8FUj1J7nI5nOQ9P9iUZyELgVY8P5FLXz0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145652637)
3. **Clinton 's endorsement of Latimer, despite his racism and Islamophobia, sends a clear message to BIPOC voters**

Finally, as if embracing MAGA funding and opposing Biden's economic plan wasn't already disqualifying, George Latimer is also running his campaign as someone willing to throw BIPOC communities under the bus. And I don't just mean his deeply upsetting history of [slow walking desegregation efforts](https://substack.com/redirect/84591012-8600-4099-b96f-219771d37342?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), because he proved his disdain for people of color again just last week. During a League of Women Voters debate he maligned Congressman Jamaal Bowman by stating, "[Your constituency is Dearborn, Michigan](https://substack.com/redirect/08e028a9-bb29-4716-89e4-a88788c6f851?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Dearborn, of course has the highest per capita population of Muslim Americans in the country. The Arab-American Institute [tweeted in response](https://substack.com/redirect/f768f3dd-0d5f-48fe-81f2-546961c4b42e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Shame on [@LatimerforNY](https://substack.com/redirect/c6bd0dfe-7fbd-4619-b5a1-22aa9aa1618a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for thinking city w/highest concentration of [#ArabAmericans](https://substack.com/redirect/a91df3f1-f5eb-4787-9f7b-4476f626548b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a way to attack [@JamaalBowmanNY](https://substack.com/redirect/4022af82-7074-4f58-b606-34983cafd1d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by reportedly saying "Your constituency is Dearborn, Michigan." We're everyone's constituency & anti-Arab racism must be condemned.
SiriusXM Radio Host and Activist [Dean Obeidallah added](https://substack.com/redirect/5fedda1b-4ecd-460b-a328-aa3076fd2d78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Hillary just endorsed a man who openly trafficked in anti-Muslim and anti-Arab bigotry. Anti-Muslim hate--just like anti-Jewish hate--has no place in the Democratic party. Hillary 100% knows what Latimer did- she simply doesn't care.
Likewise, Democrat and Georgia State Representative Ruwa Romman [tweeted her frustration](https://substack.com/redirect/9e229233-90dd-4e79-b684-f7f965988e95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> This [Clinton] endorsement coming right after Latimer's islamophobic comments is on brand tbh, and I'm tired of everyone ignoring it.
Latimer's bigoted comment is why I've long said that Islamophobia is one of the last acceptable forms of bigotry in the United States, and certain Democrats like Latimer (and apparently Hillary Clinton) happily employ it if they believe it will earn them votes.
So far, Latimer has faced zero public backlash from any politician or person in power--Democrat or Republican--for his anti-Muslim and anti-Arab comment. By contrast, imagine the (rightful) outrage if Bowman accused Latimer of paying homage to the highest per capita Jewish population in America? It would rightly be inexcusable because both Islamophobia and antisemitism should have no place in our political discourse.
Latimer's racism towards Dearborn and Clinton's subsequent endorsement is even more perplexing given Dearborn voted for Clinton nearly 70/30 in 2016. And thus the crux of the matter. If the establishment Democrat response to the Arab American and Muslim American community voting for a Democratic Presidential candidate by more than 2-1 is to not protect those communities, but to instead elevate the very politicians using MAGA Trump bigotry to demonize Arab American and Muslim American communities, then why should that voter loyalty remain? Endorsing such hate is a clear message that our votes don't matter. And as close as the 2024 election in November is shaping up to be, this is a profoundly backwards and arrogant strategy.

**In Conclusion**
Imagine if someone told you the day after the 2016 Presidential election, that within a decade Hillary Clinton would endorse a candidate for Congress against an incumbent Democrat, a candidate who is MAGA funded, who opposes the Democrat President's economic agenda, and who embraces racist tropes to win votes? You'd likely call them crazy and ask if Hillary joined the Republican Party?
Unfortunately, we don't have to imagine that scenario, because that candidate exists in George Latimer and that endorsement exists from Hillary Clinton. I don't know how to convince Hillary to rescind her endorsement and instead get behind Bowman, but I found an old quote from a candidate running a principled campaign against a bigot some years ago that might help her reflect. [They said](https://substack.com/redirect/32ca449d-a9bc-47ab-ac95-73d4e8b2e3e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):

Despite this stark plea for humanity and dignity, that candidate lost their election, and that "racist, sexist, homophobic, xenophobic, Islamaphobic" bigotry spread rapidly.
The losing candidate who delivered the above quote was none other than Hillary Clinton in 2016. Today in 2024, rather than "lift up and give voice" to a MAGA funded, anti-working family, openly racist candidate for Congress, I encourage her to follow her own advice, support Congressman Jamaal Bowman, and reject such hateful mean-spirited rhetoric.
After all, that would be the principled, Democratic thing to do.

Trump supporters aren't even bothering to be subtle or not cross the line anymore, they are thuggishly and brazenly going too far, and openly talking about killing Biden and going after his supporters. Enough is enough. It's time to prosecute them, and to put them in jail. We're tackling election integrity head-on. Be part of the solution. | | | [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=66668e9cf8&e=5c740fa3e2)

| This week's 3 most important things you need to know or actions you need to take to help us recapture our cities, state, and nation.

Thank you for subscribing & staying subscribed!

**BE SURE TO HAVE YOUR FAMILY & FRIENDS "JOIN US":**

---
| [Join Us!](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=1cbaace592&e=5c740fa3e2 "Join Us!")
---
| | | **
CONCERNED ABOUT ELECTION
INTEGRITY IN OHIO?
YOU SHOULD BE!
WHERE TO GO TO KNOW WHY!**

---
|
Election Integrity is a concern for many Ohioans. Our Secretary of State, Frank LaRose, tells us Ohio holds "gold standard" elections. Nothing could be further from the truth!

We must be educated on the weaknesses, vulnerability, and ways Ohio's voting systems can be compromised. Then, we must help others to understand and take action.

Education is the first step, so here are 3 sources of Ohio election integrity information that you should bookmark & check frequently:

[**Ohio Election Integrity News**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=263fadbf2a&e=5c740fa3e2)
This is a GFI effort. Go to the webpage [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=ed86b41b39&e=5c740fa3e2) to find a regularly-updated listing of election integrity news & resources important for Ohioans to know & know about. This was launched today, Sunday June 16th, and is a work in progress by many volunteers. If you have something you feel should be added, call or text Mark Pukita at 614-499-0599 (cell).

[**The Ohio Election Integrity Network (OEIN)**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=864fd5c396&e=5c740fa3e2)
OEIN is a statewide team of volunteers working to ensure our elections are fair & accurate, conforming to all current state & federal laws.

OEIN needs more volunteers. They need your help. To do your part go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=238fe0754f&e=5c740fa3e2) and get on their mailing list!

[**Ohio4Truth.com**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=05fc43e5ee&e=5c740fa3e2)
Ohio4Truth.com is a site that's "Sharing the Truth about Ohio Elections by Citizen Volunteer Researchers". It's an absolute encyclopedia of information and data that proves just how poorly our elections are run in Ohio. This is a "must bookmark" website.
######
---
| [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=df91042149&e=5c740fa3e2)
---
|
---
| |
**ALERT: OHIO PARENTS!
FIX OUR PUBLIC SCHOOLS!
BECOME A BOARD MEMBER!
HERE'S HOW! **

---
|
**WE NEED MORE PARENTS & GRANDPARENTS ACROSS OHIO TO STEP UP & RUN FOR SCHOOL BOARD!**

Next year, in November of 2025, all public school districts in Ohio will have at least 2 school board seats up for re-election, or if there is no incumbent for the seat, up for election.

We need concerned citizens who are for parental rights, a return to the basics of education, and completely depoliticizing Ohio's public schools, to run for these school board seats.

Anyone can run & there is no need for any kind of special qualifications, experience, or skills. All that's needed is a desire & common sense.

And, the Ohio School Board Constitutional Coalition (OSBCC) can help you every step of the way. 40% of the candidates they helped last election won!

If you are interested, or know someone who is, please, please, please make sure you (or they) visit the OSBCC website & register to start getting OSBCC's regular emails & training notices [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=9baf24eb56&e=5c740fa3e2) or by clicking on the image below

If you (or they) are anxious to start preparing to run for a school board seat, go to (or have them go to) the contact page & send OSBCC an email or fill out the contact form [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=1ef92bb97b&e=5c740fa3e2). The volunteers at OSBCC will get back to you to get you started off strong. It's not too early to start your campaign!

THANK YOU!
---
| [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=bc88580471&e=5c740fa3e2)
---
|
---
| |
**KEEP AMERICA FOR AMERICANS!
CHINA'S SILENT WAR ON AMERICA!
WEEK 4 • LESSON 4**

---
|
In May we sent out a one-time special message about a new initiative called "[**America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=4e861ce0e3&e=5c740fa3e2)" designed to wake up more Ohioans to the threat China poses to our communities, state, and nation. If you haven't seen that message, you can access a copy of it on the web [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=08fdc1d64b&e=5c740fa3e2).

Part of this initiative is an Ohio-developed, 10-week "course" titled “**China’s Silent War on America** ”. A lesson will be released every week for 10 weeks. To remind you, we'll highlight new lessons in this email. Last week we highlighted [**Lesson 3**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=349b171505&e=5c740fa3e2). This week, we're highlighting [**Lesson 4**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=f520a87a3e&e=5c740fa3e2): **China’s United Front Work Transforms America through Social Media, Our Economy and Our Schools[.](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=dca7e56145&e=5c740fa3e2)**

[**America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=2f02246bc6&e=5c740fa3e2) will provide a short lesson, one a week for ten weeks, to educate us on the many strategies China is using to undermine America’s power at home and abroad, while enriching its own homeland. The reader will also be guided towards action items to help reduce China’s influence in the state of Ohio.

Click [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=8e60af6581&e=5c740fa3e2) or on the image below to access **Lesson 4** of “**China’s Silent War on America** ” called **"[China’s United Front Work Transforms America through Social Media, Our Economy and Our Schools](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=dfd935b08b&e=5c740fa3e2)".**

_Next week's lesson, Lesson 5, will be the second of 5 lessons providing examples of China’s United Front's work in America and show how each of these initiatives undermines America’s national security._

THANK YOU!

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Join Thousands in Defense of Religious Liberty
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWGgExLWFN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWGgExLWFN

Dear Fellow American,

I am reaching out today because I believe that you,
like me, are concerned about the increasing trend of legal
persecution against Americans who wish to live their lives
according to their faith. Our cornerstones of faith, liberty,
community, and life form the bedrock of our great nation, and we
need your help to maintain them.

From a high school football coach in Washington who
lost his job for praying on the field (KENNEDY v. BREMERTON
SCHOOL DISTRICT), to a Colorado baker hauled through the legal
system multiple times for not wanting to bake a cake that
violated his religious convictions (MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v.
COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION), we can't ignore the gradual
erosion of religious freedom in America.

That's why I created the American Cornerstone
Institute to advocate for commonsense solutions to these issues
and to strengthen the bonds that keep our nation united. But we
can't do it alone.

We need your voice.

I want to personally invite you to participate in
this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in
America.

You can share your thoughts using this secure link:
https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/

Your responses are confidential and will be used
solely towards furthering our advocacy efforts.

Please, take a few minutes of your time to complete
the survey. Your input is vital in helping us understand the
scope of these issues and develop impactful strategies to
counteract them.

Your opinion truly matters. Together, we can ensure
that religious liberty continues to thrive as an integral part of
our American society.

For Liberty,

Dr. Ben Carson

Founder and Chairman

American Cornerstone Institute

Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our
mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious
liberty, helping our country's most vulnerable find new hope, and
developing methods to decrease the federal government's role in
society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's
citizens.

Copyright © 2023 American Cornerstone Institute,
All rights reserved.

| |
#### 06/17/2024
Dear family and supporters, Ballots are due soon! We are 8 days away. June 25th is the final day for your ballot to be received. You can either drop it off at a ballot-drop box or vote in person.

Right now - our campaign's number one priority is getting out the vote. We are in the community can have started canvassing every day, meeting more and more voters.

See where we’ve been this past week.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers Open House Trade Program
The IBEW trade program offers learning opportunities for students interested in pursuing a career in electrical engineering - all while earning money and without the student debt
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Manitou Spring's Farmers Market
We talked to voters in Manitou Springs this weekend - and bough some eggs too.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Juneteenth Festival
We celebrated Freedom and Black culture - with a weekend-long festival at America the Beautiful Park.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Sip, Bid, and be Inspired
Our fundraising Silent Auction at the Hero's Hollow
---
|
---
|
---
---
| | | Celebrating Recent Endorsements* This week we picked up a handful of endorsements. The Coalition of Black Trade Unionists, RTD Director Julien Bouquet, and Green Party leader, Bob Kinsey.

Thank you all for your support!

*Mom's Demand Action - Gun Sense Candide is a Distinction
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
|
---
| **More to Come** Find me this week at the NAACP Freedom Fund, Western Street Breakfast, or of course, Canvassing - we will be doing some canvassing every day between now and the election.

It's the final push - and we need to get out the vote.
---
|
---
|
---
| **It's not too late to get a yard sign (we have a few left but are not making any additional orders until September/October). Once it's gone, it's gone. **
---
|
---
---
| [Order yours today](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=b6918044e9&e=3818d77efc "Order yours today")
---
|
---
| Final Thoughts of the Week The 12-day to Primaries FEC filing was recently submitted, and we still have more individual contributors than any other candidate of any party! It's the people who vote in the end, not dollars.

But we still need help! We need to remind our voters to vote - so we are launching a massive texting campaign to our voters who haven't turned their ballots in yet (and there are still more than 50,000 people who need this reminder).

Every $50 gets us an additional 1000 texts. We predict this election to be close, so every vote counts - and every dollar counts.

Donations made**now** will help us get the strongest candidate elected next week!

Thank you for your support. Sincerely, River Gassen - Democratic Candidate for Colorado’s 5th Congressional District

name: Dan Jacoby
subject: From Lori Camp for Congress: Thank you for volunteering!
body:
Hi,

I am writing to you as a consultant for Lori Camp’s campaign. I will be helping her with Field Operations – that is, direct voter contact.

**About me: **I started my career in politics in 2003 as a volunteer, and since then have knocked on over 20,000 doors, made countless phone calls, attended and helped with tons of events – and been paid to work on campaigns in five states across the country, literally from coast to coast. I am a graduate (some time ago) from South Bend Adams High School, and am thrilled to “go home again” to restore the 2nd congressional district to its proper blue color. (Back then it was the 3rd district, and my first vote was for John Brademas.)

**About you: **You signed up to volunteer for this campaign, meaning you’re willing to donate some of your time, talents, and energy toward flipping this seat. Each of you has your own individual story of what led you here and why you signed up, and your story is important because your story is why you can be an effective voice for this campaign. My job is to help you get your story out to as many people as possible; it’s those personal connections that make all the difference.

To this end, we are bringing in some new tools, methods and approaches. Over the next several weeks I will be setting up training sessions so that you’ll be up to speed.

In the meantime, I’d love to hear from you! Some of you have let the campaign know what activities you prefer, but everyone should feel free to chime in - and be ready to expand your repertoire.

To give you an idea, here’s my “first time volunteering” story:

In 2003 I walked into a meet up for Howard Dean. (“Meetups” were new then, and we’re grassroots meetings not connected to a campaign.) I was 40 years old, and the campaign had sent a 20-something year old staffer to talk with us. I decided that if this kid could be on staff I should be able to bring my experience in life as well.

So the next day I walked into the campaign’s local office and announced that I was there to help the campaign. They brought out the volunteer coordinator (another 20-something) who thanked me for coming in and said that they really needed someone to answer the telephone.

That was when I made one of the wisest decisions of my life. I did what they said they needed. “Good morning. Dean for America. How May I direct your call?” That decision led to me being here emailing you.

I look forward to getting all of you out on the campaign trail, helping to send Lori to Congress.

All the best,
Dan Jacoby

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: My coming out story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
#
Hi there, can I share something with you?
When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly.
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-baldwin-split.kt1qkh&refcode=em240617-1-c&t=1&akid=5333%2E196590%2ElSbEOL)
After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both:
**I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.**
When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.
That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too.
[**I’m facing my most competitive and expensive reelection yet, so I can’t keep up this work without your help. Will you help me continue to make a difference by splitting a donation between The Long Run and my reelection campaign today?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-baldwin-split.kt1qkh&refcode=em240617-1-c&t=2&akid=5333%2E196590%2ElSbEOL)

---
****
We have made incredible progress over the years in the fight for equality — but folks, we cannot mistake that progress for a total victory.
Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth. **In 2024 alone, 515 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced across the country.**
It’s going to take all of us to counter these right wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong, and that kindness and inclusion — not hatred and division — are American values.
[**This Pride Month, I’m hoping you’ll support this important work by splitting a donation between The Long Run and my reelection campaign to send me back to the United States Senate.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-baldwin-split.kt1qkh&refcode=em240617-1-c&t=27&akid=5333%2E196590%2ElSbEOL)
[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-baldwin-split.kt1qkh&refcode=em240617-1-c&t=28&akid=5333%2E196590%2ElSbEOL)
Thank you for your ongoing support. Let’s recommit ourselves to work towards the day when all LGBTQ+ Americans can live in a world where they feel safe, accepted, and loved.
Happy Pride! 🏳️🌈
— Tammy

body:
Some people today would have you believe that our nation was founded on secular principles...

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6gn6ttecf7jvenkk60vbh1m15pqkilvqspeh4i8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdim0o71c9h2bs)
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2znf8n1njj3rbb4111ou6i1ocplf5p7d4fbgstd8g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdim0o71c9h2bs) Hello Friend, ____ Some people today would have you believe that our nation was founded on secular principles, insisting that "a great wall of separation between Church and State" has always been our guiding principle. They claim that the founders intended for Christianity to be completely absent from all forms of government.

These assertions are false, and I can prove it. In fact, I have demonstrated it in my book America Is a Christian Nation, using the words and actions of the founders themselves.

The truth is that, over time, secularists, humanists, and atheists have distorted our Constitution into something the founding fathers never intended.

I invite you to read _America Is a Christian Nation_ to understand how our country has shifted from its reliance on God to a rejection of God--and how we can return to those roots of dependence on Him.

It's a concise read, beautifully complemented by stunning patriotic photos that you'll be sure to enjoy.

To express our appreciation for any gift you can make to _Pathway to Victory_ today, we'd like to send you a copy of this book. I know you'll find it both informative and engaging.

You can receive your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ by making your matched donation here: [https://secure.ptv.org/america-is-a-christian-nation-generous-gift-1](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5b5v0pnm31emtk7dkb3k3rbsupcgrddsdtlf1hg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30sdim0o71c9h2bs)

As believers, we need to do all we can to preserve America's unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. I hope you'll join me in this important work.

Thank you for your support of this ministry.

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

Friends,
It's the political season. You're bombarded with requests from politicians for money. It's overwhelming and exhausting. I get it.
Growing up lower-middle class, I couldn't fathom giving to a candidate. Especially now, after being involved in politics, I fundamentally believe in campaign finance reform. Big money, corporate PACs, and ultra-wealthy donors looking for political influence shouldn't shape our elections.
But that's precisely why we come to you, asking for $5, $10, $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] , whatever you can spare. Unlike many candidates, my campaign is fueled exclusively by hardworking, everyday people chipping in what they can, when they can. We rely on small-amount donations because people believe in the cause.
It's so important we keep momentum.
As we get ready to face off against MAGA extremist, Trump-endorsed Rep. Jack Bergman, we have the best campaign to finally defeat him, but we have to win big in August first, and it will require more resources.
We have ads to buy, yard signs to deliver, and literature to order for our massive door-knocking program. It's all contingent upon having enough funds to win.
I hate saying that. Truly. I want to get to Congress to help people's pocketbooks, not align my own. Rest assured, every dollar you contribute goes to my hardworking staff, travel expenses, and necessary infrastructure and outreach that keeps us at the forefront of voters' minds.
Voting begins soon, and every new day, I need you more than ever. If you've given recently, thank you. I am eternally grateful. It means more than you know, and we will continue to express our gratitude.
Thank you for being part of this movement. We're fighting for universal healthcare, affordable housing, childcare, and education. We're advocating for women's rights, LGBTQ rights, workers' rights, and especially an economic / tax system that works for everyone, not just corporations and billionaires. We need livable wages, union protections, and better jobs.
We can get there with your help.
Your donations help me keep up our fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aboutbob]
I'm always available to chat if you have any questions about the campaign. Feel free to reply, and I will contact you.

And his conspiracies and election denial pushed our democracy to the brink on January 6th. Folks, a quick note here from me. I like to take a couple minutes to myself when I can, and reflect about why we’re doing this work. Today I was thinking back to what it felt like in 2016 when Trump won. That terrible, terrible feeling. We didn’t know exactly what would come next, but we knew it would be bad. Trump’s Supreme Court — his appointed justices — struck down Roe v. Wade. His “leadership” in the pandemic led to more than a million deaths. And his conspiracies and election denial pushed our democracy to the brink on January 6th. Do not, ever, let anyone tell you that elections do not matter. I wake up every day ready to do whatever I can to defeat Kari Lake, Trump’s “MAGA Queen.” She’s dangerous enough on her own, but if she and Trump both win in Arizona this year, we’re all in big trouble. The work we do between now and November is going to make all the difference on election day, and we have to make the most of each day. Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to my campaign. Consider it an act of hope — hope that we can continue the progress we’ve made over the last few years, and that we can stop folks like Trump and Lake from gaining any more power and influence.
