Peter, there’s a lot of bragging going on here in Virginia’s 10th district.
Every day, my opponents send out emails bragging about how much money they’ve raised in a given month. Sometimes it’s more than I’ve raised, sometimes it’s not.
Here’s what I know, Peter: this race isn’t all about money.
Yes, money is necessary to implement our campaign plan. But voters can’t be purchased, and when I knock on a door to talk to someone about my plans for our community, you can bet they don’t ask me how much money I raised that day.
They ask how I’m going to fight for them in Congress, and here’s what I tell them.
I’m going to go to D.C. and fight like hell for our shared values. I’m going to stand up to every single Republican who’s trying to strip women of our reproductive rights. I’m going to work to address issues like mental health, gun violence, and pay inequity. And I’m going to work to restore our Democracy and undo the damage done by wannabe dictator Donald Trump.
Peter, we’re 24 hours away from the primary election, and I need you with me in this fight. If you stand with me, will you add your name? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/boysko_upsl?refcode=061724_1]

Jennifer

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On Message
from Michael B. Moore
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're happy you're here.
We're using this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events, and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st Congressional District.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On the calendar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104585/images/210614-charleston-church-mn-1405-9bc08a.jpg]
Nine years ago today, nine Black worshippers were murdered inside Mother Emanuel AME Church [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid02FhDMRTtTSidwdWfMFWt9WVPM3qs6Pz8vKkYejkZL62eGWZVT8phcYLwvRJKU4Frxl] simply because of the color of their skin.
While we honor their memories and sacrifice, let us also reject the forces of hate and extremism — and recommit ourselves to passing commonsense gun reforms that could help prevent another massacre.
In the news
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
In case you hadn't heard, Michael officially won the Democratic nomination for SC-01 [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid07FWkMH5VBx52GBGZECpR91bnc3q7chCiysJmsgAiRkEQDwiwE4vWUchk7FbZrxdEl] last week!
We're sincerely grateful to every single Lowcountry voter who showed up at the polls to support our hopeful vision for the future of this district.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Our grassroots movement is energizing Democratic voters, persuading independent-minded Republicans, and assembling the coalition needed to win this critical election [https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=264752503393188] .
Come November, we're going to defeat Nancy Mace and flip this seat.
From the trail
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Our team enjoyed several Juneteenth events [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid02fSMSb76WBcw1YRSK83WUVt1iSaJ63qCKqEBTEtkKZjn5ESbzX8npg8UBvZm5sE9yl] over the weekend, including celebrations in Mount Pleasant and North Charleston!
This important holiday exemplifies all the Lowcountry values our campaign stands for: individual freedom, equality, and liberty and justice for all.
On our team
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
There's so much work to do, and we're only just getting started.
Join us in our fight to flip this swing district.
Together, we're going to build a brighter future for South Carolina.

Hello, Derek. Trump and the RNC’s fundraising numbers -- $141 million in the month of May alone -- make this a make-or-break moment for Democrats in this election. It’s a moment that reminds me of Bobby Kennedy’s eulogy of his brother, President John F. Kennedy, at the Democratic convention. Bobby Kennedy said that JFK would have never been able to accomplish any of what he did without the support of all of you -- the Democratic Party. He said that when we’re in it together, we can accomplish a great deal. That's true in helping President Biden defeat Donald Trump; it's true in electing Democrats up and down the ballot; and it's true when it comes to continuing the progress of the last several years. Making sure we can close the fundraising gap on Trump and the RNC is a critical task. A top priority. But it will take all of us coming together to get it done. It will take a party. name: Maura Healey
subject: This November, I'll have Pride in mind
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Friends,
I want to wish you a very Happy Pride Month. As the state that led the nation on marriage equality and continues to stand with the LGBTQ+ community every day, Massachusetts embodies Pride like nowhere else.
>From Pittsfield to Provincetown, our LGBTQ+ leaders and activists have been an integral part of the history of Massachusetts, and I’m excited to celebrate this month with every one of you.
When I reflect on the strides our community has made, I think of those who came before us and bravely paved the way for acceptance. People like my friend, the late Ann Maguire. Ann managed the campaign of Elaine Noble, whose election to the Massachusetts State House made her the first openly gay person elected to a state-level office in the United States.
Ann went on to found the Boston Lesbian & Gay Political Alliance and serve as the Boston Mayor’s Liaison to the LGBT Community, among countless other contributions. Her passing this past December was a loss for us all, and we owe it to Ann and trailblazers like her to stand proud not only this month, but every day of the year.
We have made strides in Massachusetts — from banning conversion therapy to making sure that no one can be discriminated against on the basis of their sexual orientation or gender identity. But at a time when our community is under attack around the country, now is not the time to ease up.
This November, we cannot allow hatred to turn back the clock. When I cast my ballot, I’ll have Pride in mind. In the fall, I’ll be voting for candidates who will stand up for our rights and protect the most vulnerable. I hope you will too.
- Maura Healey

Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people. **
| | [Elect Lucas Kunce](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87073526/479943977/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3984-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDdmOTI2Yy1jYzJjLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sjmd0IKHD9OwU1fNil5DcIt5-E4J-N1p-6HgbrnqmG0=)

**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself. **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87073527/479943978/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3984-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDdmOTI2Yy1jYzJjLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sjmd0IKHD9OwU1fNil5DcIt5-E4J-N1p-6HgbrnqmG0=)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about “Manhood.”
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87073528/479943979/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3984-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDdmOTI2Yy1jYzJjLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Sjmd0IKHD9OwU1fNil5DcIt5-E4J-N1p-6HgbrnqmG0=)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, friend, and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
**_Morning Consult_ reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November.** And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
After spending a whole year consolidating support from workers, community leaders, and organizations across Missouri, Lucas Kunce has more than proved that he has what it takes to win this race. Multiple polls even confirm he’s in a dead heat with Hawley. That’s why I’m asking for your help, friend:

# Liberty V Communism
### We must STAND
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Jun 17
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
Dear Friend,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to express my deep commitment to the principles of liberty and my firm opposition to the ideology of communism.

Throughout history, communism has consistently demonstrated its potential to undermine individual freedoms and economic prosperity. The centralization of power and the suppression of dissent inherent in communist regimes have led to widespread human rights abuses, economic inefficiencies, and a general erosion of the individual liberties we hold dear.

In contrast, the values of liberty, including freedom of speech, freedom of assembly, and the right to private property, form the bedrock of a thriving, dynamic society. These principles not only encourage innovation and personal responsibility but also ensure that each individual has the opportunity to pursue their own path to happiness and success.

In light of recent global trends and discussions, it is more important than ever to reaffirm our commitment to these fundamental liberties. We must remain vigilant against any encroachments on our freedoms, whether they come from within or from external forces advocating for a communist agenda.

I urge you to join me in standing firmly for liberty and against the spread of communism. Together, we can ensure that our society remains a bastion of freedom and opportunity for all.

Sincerely,

Dan Carr

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: We came up short of our goal
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| Every deadline matters in a race as expensive as ours.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2838%2E35263%2EEEryqq)
I wanted you to hear this from me, Peter: We came up short of our mid-month fundraising goal over the weekend. I won’t be alarmist or tell you that the sky is falling because we fell behind — it’s not, and that’s not how we do things. But these deadlines do matter in a race as expensive as ours. My Republican opponent and dark money groups are spending a fortune to flip my seat red. First, it was $5 million, then $10 million, **and now they’ve spent a combined $14 million uplifting Eric Hovde and attacking our campaign.** My megamillionaire opponent is trying to buy this Senate seat, and it’s forced us to raise our own fundraising goals and spend more than we originally anticipated in order to stay competitive in the polls. With a public fundraising deadline approaching at the end of the month, we only have a couple of weeks to balance our campaign budget and post the strongest numbers possible. body:
President Trump Endorses Nancy Dahlstrom for Congress
*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|*

View this email in your browser

3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61547>

June 17, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

President Trump Endorses Nancy Dahlstrom for Congress

ANCHORAGE, AK - On Monday, President Donald J. Trump endorsed
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69116&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61548> Alaska Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom in
her run for the at-large congressional seat currently occupied by Mary
Peltola.

President Trump gave Lt. Governor Dahlstrom a glowing endorsement,
calling her a "proven fighter" and noting that she "will be a
tremendous Congresswoman for the Great People of Alaska, just as she
was as your Lieutenant Governor."

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69116&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61548>

"In Congress, she will work to Secure the Border, Create Jobs, Lower
Taxes, Promote American Energy Independence, Support our Incredible
Military and Police Officers, and Defend our always under siege Second
Amendment," President Trump wrote
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69116&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61548> on TruthSocial. "... Nancy Dahlstrom is a
WINNER, and has my Complete and Total Endorsement. SHE WILL NOT LET YOU
DOWN!"

"I thank President Trump for his endorsement. We have all felt the
effects from the Democratic mismanagement of our nation by Joe Biden
and Mary Peltola," said Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom. "Our southern
border is a mess, our dollars don't go as far anymore, and our
adversaries are emboldened across the globe. Now more than ever, we
need real conservative leadership in Washington to right the ship and I
look forward to working with President Trump to Make America Great
Again when we're both in Washington."

You can read President Trump's full endorsement of Lt. Governor
Dahlstrom here
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69116&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61548> .

name: Candace Owens, BLEXIT
subject: Thanking police officers
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Friend,

I am so grateful for our police officers.

As an American who believes in law and order,
truth, and justice, I have always stood with the public servants
who protect our communities.

Please join me in thanking uniformed men and women
by signing our 'Back the Blue Petition' and letting brave
officers know that we are grateful for their service and
sacrifice.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began
propelling criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to
"defund the police."

I refuse to accept that we must cater to the bottom
denominator of our society and that the black community must
fight and scream and demand support for the people in our
community who are up to no good.

That's one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT - an
organization focused on shifting the culture in Black America as
well as educating and uplifting minorities through educational
programs and acts of community service.

Around the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have
supported local officers, while so many others have turned their
backs on those who serve our communities.

To join these chapters and stand with police
officers, please sign the national petition today.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

This summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving
back to the Baltimore Police Department and learned some history
about the city's police force.

The first state chapter - BLEXIT North Carolina -
paid a visit to local officers in July. Our State Director
showered them with thank-you notes and delicious food as a token
of BLEXIT's appreciation.

If you 'Back the Blue' - and believe that we must
support local heroes - please sign the national petition right
away.

While the 'defund the police' crowd wants us to
think minorities stand with them - polls show that the vast
majority of black voters (more than 80%) want police funding to
stay the same or even increase.

We've been sold a lot of lies by anti-police
radicals - those lies have been a detriment to Black American
culture, the country as a whole, and the police officers who
fight for justice every day.

We must stop the deception that is harming urban
communities and demeaning police around the nation.

If you are an American, no matter what color you
are, you should want law and you should want order. That is the
way forward.

Join me in letting our police officers know that
you support law and order, justice, and their valiant efforts to
keep our communities safe.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

Candace Owens

Chair of BLEXIT

name: Kamala Harris
subject: Cheaters don't like getting caught
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Biden for President
body:
Joe and I can't defend our democracy and protect our progress without supporters like you. | | |
---
Peter -- I began my career as a young prosecutor in Alameda County, California. Now, as Vice President of the United States, President Biden and I are running for reelection against Donald Trump, fresh off his trial where a jury of his peers unanimously found him guilty on 34 counts. Since the verdict, Trump has attacked the judge and the witnesses, and said he is entitled to revenge. The simple reality is: **Cheaters don't like getting caught.** But the true test will be what happens November 5, and we need your help. Trump's team raised $141 million last month to retake the White House. # Thank You, Everyone!
---
---
| [](https://eqbp6ugbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FNn1B3TcNA5gChZo9qjralagDRwkTGzCzYMF5buHYRgobc8DJFBpYrc0g-vy7fyRrNUKgW9AP7Rmrg9oQ9MPgbiQiKJu3oZzk6DUXg2wfkxMPo7XOewvxvQCr8Hq2D9Iu8gb3YjXuMHvYbjb6BzwO9HgKBpM3h7XZ8VmzsfnQG0kli0RXiOiqg==&c=3njpwUYxImPfcf9CI3gOIYv3JnA-BUlsb3yKVsOchweIW3HJeceSnQ==&ch=u3g-ejQmcM7KdfvQWJ3oIiI7nl4dtT8fbrI-quvHhAuG9O2tePtvqQ==)
---
|
Peter,
It's been almost a week since we last communicated. I just wanted to take the time to send a heartfelt thank you to everyone who supported the campaign. Your hard work and enthusiasm were amazing. The opportunity to run to represent the Second District in Congress was an honor and it provided me an experience that was absolutely worth the effort even though we did not prevail.
My term in the 131st Legislature will continue until early January 2025. From now until then I will continue to work hard on the issues that I can have an impact on at the state level. I am committed to making Mainers' lives better, safer and more prosperous.
On this journey across the Second District, I met the people of Maine and heard their stories and their concerns. I learned about their daily triumphs and daily struggles. Those conversations have left a mark on me that will never go away. This state is our home, and we can never stop fighting for her, for our families and for Maine's future generations.
I know that I will remain involved in the effort to make Maine the best that she can be. I hope that all of you will join me.
Thank you, stay safe.
Mike
---
---
| | | Mike Soboleski is a born and raised Mainer and a lifelong conservative with Maine values. He's running for Congress in Maine's Second Congressional District because he knows our state and country are going in the wrong direction.
Please help spread the word by forwarding our email to friends and family.

subject: Right-wing billionaires are attacking pro-Palestine legislators
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

AIPAC’s Super PAC recently spent over $10 million to flood the airwaves
attacking Rep. Jamaal Bowman, who’s an outspoken advocate for
Palestinians’ human rights.

The anti-Palestinian group is planning to spend $20 million to try to
unseat Jamaal Bowman in his fast-approaching June 25th Democratic primary
re-election to Congress.

Funded primarily by far-right billionaires, AIPAC keeps trying to bring
down progressive and working-class candidates of color like Jamaal Bowman,
who rely on grassroots donations rather than corporate PAC money.

Jamaal is the first Black person to represent his district. Meanwhile, his
handpicked-by-AIPAC opponent is spreading racist and Islamophobic lies
about Jamaal, and encouraging Republicans to switch parties to vote in the
Democratic primary election.

We can’t let Republicans buy Democratic elections, and we need to keep
strong advocates for human rights like Jamaal in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240617-rt-jb.2TrQHK&refcode=em20240617-35287&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=35287%2E1203867%2Ev9jkZQ ]Can you chip in today to Justice Democrats and my and Rep. Jamaal
Bowman’s re-election campaigns? With your support, we can stay in Congress
fighting to expand human rights for all, including pushing for Black and
Palestinian liberation.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240617-rt-jb.2TrQHK&refcode=em20240617-35287&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35287%2E1203867%2Ev9jkZQ ]Chip In

AIPAC undermines our democracy, including by endorsing insurrectionist
Congresspeople who voted to overturn 2020’s election results.

As one of Jamaal’s campaign advisors noted, the attempt “to unseat Jamaal
Bowman is heavily funded by the same Republican mega-donors who’ve spent
millions to elect Donald Trump.”

Meanwhile, Jamaal is one of the strongest progressives in Congress. He is
unafraid to push for the transformational policies that our communities
deserve, and he understands that our basic human needs should not be
treated as commodities for profit.

I’ve been proud to cosponsor Jamaal’s bills to support Black history
education programs, to make a Green New Deal for public schools, to stop
the racist and antisemitic “great replacement theory,” and more. Together,
we’ve introduced legislation to pay musicians fairly and to secure the
human right to utilities such as water and electricity.

I need Jamaal Bowman by my side in Congress, especially as too many of our
colleagues continue neglecting our communities’ needs while sending
billions of U.S. taxpayer dollars to bomb Gaza. Like me, Jamaal doesn’t
take any money from corporate PACs, instead relying on grassroots
donations.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240617-rt-jb.2TrQHK&refcode=em20240617-35287&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1003&akid=35287%2E1203867%2Ev9jkZQ ]Please chip in to Justice Democrats and my and Jamaal Bowman’s
re-election campaigns today so we can withstand AIPAC’s attacks and stay
in Congress, building a multi-racial democracy where everyone can thrive.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240617-rt-jb.2TrQHK&refcode=em20240617-35287&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1022&akid=35287%2E1203867%2Ev9jkZQ ]Contribute $3

Thank you for continuing to grow our movement for equal rights, freedom,
and human dignity for all.

-Rashida

subject: Revisionists are trying to change America’s roots
body:

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=feb5df397f44474bb55a0125d1fb4321&_e=5g9F8l7LjRxoAKm-f_kp3VdzRt09yJRyZDE_pKq_q-CUh5YiA8QLRmGzVPQclbggiYy2tHTZFZTgdH6Tq5snxtK2ghJRdDqHKS12Wl_PFmyjfzGPHWnt4JOVe-f5DS0hs1ouVxUzVPfUAuSmdAw1ecbeSCdH-18EwLsfcvQTQj9Nps3Zm8Tr6piBDhNOIzbcLzVrwaX4D-fseJ2A9VezpLmqLs0_pMqsiUTwwuuQja7fWjK6AIvkne1BxG8zprFXOv8O8o6VdzezGpMItA3B4bQ7wR-wGXSGqEl5jqH_NX2WPipOo6r5giurh3xtrVP09tGpKHQH2U52GKvgwS5ARzKaAMm1p8KAFm7qea9-vxiq-Cws9hUY83p-MokrVsTyMNIkKq5a1_ErtYpQKUrzdQ%3D%3D)

They claim that the founders intended for Christianity to be completely absent from all forms of government.

These assertions are false, and I can prove it. In fact, I have demonstrated it in my book America Is a Christian Nation, using the words and actions of the founders themselves.

The truth is that, over time, secularists, humanists, and atheists have distorted our Constitution into something the founding fathers never intended.

I invite you to read _America Is a Christian Nation_ to understand how our country has shifted from its reliance on God to a rejection of God--and how we can return to those roots of dependence on Him.

It's a concise read, beautifully complemented by stunning patriotic photos that you'll be sure to enjoy.

To express our appreciation for any gift you can make to _Pathway to Victory_ today, we'd like to send you a copy of this book. I know you'll find it both informative and engaging.

You can receive your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ by making your matched donation here: [https://secure.ptv.org/america-is-a-christian-nation-generous-gift-1](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=feb5df397f44474bb55a0125d1fb4321&_e=5g9F8l7LjRxoAKm-f_kp3VdzRt09yJRyZDE_pKq_q-CUh5YiA8QLRmGzVPQclbggiYy2tHTZFZTgdH6Tq5snxtK2ghJRdDqHKS12Wl_PFmyjfzGPHWnt4JOVe-f5DS0hs1ouVxUzVPfUAuSmdAw1ecbeSCdH-18EwLsfcvQTQj9Nps3Zm8Tr6piBDhNOIzbcLzVrwaX4D-fseJ2A9VezpLmqLs0_pMqsiUTwwuuQja7fWjK6AIvkne1BxG8zprFXVQGIPSAmFu5Z9gBHqA82xSlVEVrdxz5FCnJx6UCW4cAzDBTplAcG_8IxuG8aPwklqMeqy-85I1EwcW-D0ok_38sZYgW6ul7YHyi6WQ5C5-huSpnEIr98ZLT14YkfZLj-za-lUHplF1iTQwxdQ97PRw%3D%3D)

As believers, we need to do all we can to preserve America's unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. I hope you'll join me in this important work.

Thank you for your support of this ministry.

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

name: Karen Baker
subject: My whole life has been about serving others
body:
| | | | |
---
| Dear Supporter,
I've served my country for over 30 years. First, as a trial lawyer for the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission fighting against corporate discrimination. Then, as an administrative law judge immersed in the suffering of people who came before me to be heard – and I did hear them and respect them. Lastly, I served my community as a nurse working in the ICU of a small rural hospital. I cared for families, sharing their fears and celebrating recoveries.
Throughout my life, I have been guided by this quote: _“Life’s most persistent and urgent question is: What are you doing for others?” – Martin Luther King, Jr._
My whole life has been dedicated to helping others and serving my community. **When elected to Congress, my commitment will be clear: put Southwest Virginian's first.**
I can't wait to see what we can accomplish when we work together. But friend, to accomplish great things, I need your help. Will you support our campaign today? Your donation allows me to run the race we all deserve.
Thank you,Karen Baker

Then, as an administrative law judge immersed in the suffering of people who came before me to be heard – and I did hear them and respect them. Lastly, I served my community as a nurse working in the ICU of a small rural hospital. I cared for families, sharing their fears and celebrating recoveries. name: Jill Stein
subject: Not all homelessness is visible
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
The housing crisis in America is pushing millions to the brink.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=1)
---
Peter -

There is a housing crisis in America, and it goes deeper than you may know. When most people picture the unhoused, they’re imagining their fellow Americans living on the streets – sometimes in tents, sometimes in the open – visible for all to see.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=2)
---
Or they may think of people forced to live in their cars, struggling to manage the basic necessities of life in the confines of a vehicle.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=3)
---
But even that is not the full picture. Of the MILLIONS of unhoused Americans, more than 60% are “invisible” to the general public. These are the people forced out of permanent, stable housing by rent hikes or lapses in employment. They are living in hotels, crashing on friends’ couches, and otherwise finding temporary shelter that keeps them off the street – but does not keep them out of danger.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=4)
---
There was a brief period during the pandemic, when evictions were frozen to preserve public health and prevent the spread of disease. It was the first time millions of Americans experienced the affirmation that housing is both a basic human right and a general social good. **But as the pandemic eased, the landlords of America became impatient – and many became greedy.** Over 1 MILLION eviction cases were filed in the U.S. in 2023 – a 10% increase over 2022 and more than double the total evictions in 2021. **Rents increased as much as 30% – far outpacing wages AND inflation.** Even many Americans with strong credit and a stable rental history have found themselves on the verge of homelessness because their landlord changed the terms of their lease without notice. [**I believe that housing is a human right, full stop. I’m running for President to ensure everyone has a safe, stable place to call home.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=5)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=6 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=6)
---
The most shocking and appalling thing to understand about America’s housing problems is that **this is a manufactured crisis.** It’s not that we have too few homes or too many people. There are roughly five times as many empty homes as there are people who live without permanent housing – and those are the conservative estimates. The appalling stereotypes of unhoused Americans are constantly reinforced by mainstream media and pop culture. ...that they are all mentally ill, addicts, or violent. ...that they're homeless because they made bad decisions or they're lazy. ...that they're unemployed or _unemployable._ Over 2.5 million unhoused or housing insecure Americans are children. Up to 60% of unhoused adults have active employment. The truth is that the majority of Americans are only a few missed paychecks away from joining this vulnerable population. It seems obvious to say it but, the truth is **the reason people are homeless is because they don't have homes. And that is a problem we can solve.** As your president, I will work to guarantee **_housing as a human right_** , with plans to build millions of affordable homes. We will prioritize getting unhoused people into homes _without preconditions –_ giving them the foundation to rebuild their lives. We will build at least 15 million green, union-built, publicly-owned homes over the next decade. And we’ll expand public transportation to serve this development, reducing traffic and pollution below current levels. This investment will address the shortage of _affordable_ housing and disincentivize private equity from buying up homes to keep as investment income. In the process we will create millions of jobs and build housing that can withstand the ravages of the climate crisis. I will safeguard tenant protections with a Universal Tenant's Bill of Rights that will protect renters from exploitation. We will support the establishment of a National Tenants Union, empowering tenants to stand up for their rights. We will implement universal rent control and prohibit excessive rental deposits. Credit checks will be eliminated from rental applications, making it easier for everyone to secure housing. These are just a few of the policies we can pursue even without a cooperative congress to provide immediate relief to American families. You can read more about my housing justice plans at [**jillstein2024.com/platform**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=Qj32F8ZTIcBOzthgR25-gF2J_V8cRlHgwGIBI_1lcLQ0Ce7w_K4rbPSVLguxOifF&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=7). **Your support is crucial in making this vision a reality. Join me in fighting for a future where housing is a right, not a privilege.**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=8 "CONTRIBUTE") [CONTRIBUTE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0617_housing_and_homelessness&n=8)

In solidarity and gratitude, Jill

I never imagined that I would be here today, Peter.

I’m a Jewish-Ukrainian immigrant whose family came to America to find hope like so many others, and I was proud to join the military and serve my country.

When my brother, Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman, and I witnessed President Trump abuse his power and threaten to block Ukraine’s military aid unless they investigated Joe Biden, we refused to stay silent.

We reported the call up the chain of command and it eventually led to his impeachment, but it cost us our careers when we were fired in retaliation.

Back then, **I never envisioned I would run for Congress,** but in the nearly five years since that phone call, the Republicans have shown the dangerous path they are willing to tread.

From the insurrection of January 6th to their assaults on fair elections and fundamental rights, Republicans have gone all-in on authoritarianism. Now, our democracy teeters on the brink.

That's why I need your support today, Peter. Our race is one of the key few that will determine party control of the House. And with just 15 days remaining until our primary election, we can’t fall behind on our fundraising if we want to beat the GOP and keep our democracy out of the dangerous hands of MAGA Republicans.

The path to winning the House majority runs through VA-7, and the only way we can win is if I have you by my side.

clean_body: | I never imagined that I would be here today, Peter. I’m a Jewish-Ukrainian immigrant whose family came to America to find hope like so many others, and I was proud to join the military and serve my country. When my brother, Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman, and I witnessed President Trump abuse his power and threaten to block Ukraine’s military aid unless they investigated Joe Biden, we refused to stay silent. We reported the call up the chain of command and it eventually led to his impeachment, but it cost us our careers when we were fired in retaliation. Back then, I never envisioned I would run for Congress, but in the nearly five years since that phone call, the Republicans have shown the dangerous path they are willing to tread. From the insurrection of January 6th to their assaults on fair elections and fundamental rights, Republicans have gone all-in on authoritarianism. Now, our democracy teeters on the brink. That's why I need your support today, Peter. Our race is one of the key few that will determine party control of the House. And with just 15 days remaining until our primary election, we can’t fall behind on our fundraising if we want to beat the GOP and keep our democracy out of the dangerous hands of MAGA Republicans. That's the way it's been and that's what federal law requires.

Peter,

Rather than championing Montana values in the Senate, Democrat Jon Tester has spent his 18-year Senate career spinning a web of lies and deceit.

He wants Montanans to believe that despite owning a **$1 million castle in DC,** he is just a third-generation dirt farmer from Montana.

He wants us to believe he is a Montana-first politician, but his record shows that _**he votes with President Joe Biden more than 95% of the time and is the #1 recipient of lobbyist cash**_.

I can’t imagine Tester has much time to tend to the farm between fancy steak dinners, galas, and other private events with D.C. insiders and lobbyists.

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3287%2E552475%2EKWg3g9)
I’m worried, Peter.
[**My finance director just texted me saying we’re falling behind on our fundraising – so before I go any further, I need to ask for your help. Will you pitch in $5 or more right now to help us stay on track?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240617-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240617-2&refcode2=3287_552475_KWg3g9&akid=3287%2E552475%2EKWg3g9)
This couldn’t have come at a worse time. A billionaire-funded super PAC announced a $30 million ad buy to blanket Pennsylvania’s airwaves, and back-to-back polls show this race is tightening.
With the Senate majority hinging on this seat, we need to close this gap in our fundraising – but unlike my hedge fund executive opponent, I don’t have millions upon millions of dollars to fund this campaign. That means I’m relying on your support more than ever to help us turn things around.
[**Can I count on you to chip in $5 or more today? Your contribution could help make the difference between a red and blue Senate.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240617-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240617-2&refcode2=3287_552475_KWg3g9&akid=3287%2E552475%2EKWg3g9)

body:
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1271%2E62735%2E2lQ21x)
Peter,
I’m Hill Harper, running for the U.S. Senate to represent Michigan. Even though my opponent and I both have a D next to our name on the ballot there are stark differences between us. Our state deserves a leader who fights for justice, fairness, and a brighter future for all.
**My opponent has turned a blind eye to crucial legislation like the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act and the Cannabis and Expungement Act.**
**I've dedicated much of my life to reducing mass incarceration.** It's heartbreaking that in our state, you can run a profitable business selling a product today for which you might have been imprisoned for just a few years ago, with no pathway to expunge that record. This isn’t justice. This is why federal expungement is crucial—it’s about fairness and giving people a real chance to rebuild their lives.
When it comes to education, **my opponent voted against student loan debt relief.** Our young people deserve opportunities, not mountains of debt. **I believe in investing in their futures.**
Healthcare is a fundamental right, yet **my opponent didn’t co-sponsor Medicare for All.** As a cancer survivor and the son of a psychiatrist, I know firsthand the importance of universal and mental healthcare. It’s unacceptable that one-third of GoFundMe campaigns are for medical expenses. **We need a system that truly cares for our people.**
**I’m not a career politician. I’m a 32-year union member, a small business owner in Detroit, and a Harvard Law graduate. But more importantly, I care deeply about our community. Titles and degrees don't matter—what matters is the heart we have for the people we serve.**
This is a pivotal moment for Michigan's future. Open Senate seats are rare, often only coming available when a Senator retires or passes away. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to elect a leader who will shape the future we all deserve.

Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://trk.secureandprosper.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM4ODM3MTYzNCIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MTY5LTEyMzkyZTVlODFmMDRiMGViYjk0NzJhOTY0YjY2ZjkyIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2xwLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvdGFrZS10aGUtbmF0aW9uYWwtc3VydmV5LW9uLXNvY2lhbGlzbS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1zb2NpYWxpc21zdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QUVfU1BPNTA0MTkmc2M9MDAwODFOMDI0MklFV0RPREVFUSJ9/0jAyCGC-H7roP_ND4AsoJQ)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. Hi there, can I share something with you? When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that. body:
Judicial Watch announced today it received 110 pages of heavily redacted records from the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit that show state election officials in the days before and after the 2020 election flagging online content deemed “misinformation” and sending it to the Center for Internet Security (CIS), a DHS-funded nonprofit, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), the Election Integrity Partnership (EIP), and others.

June 17th Newsletter
Dear neighbors,
Can you believe we are halfway through the month of June? This week is shaping up to be a busy one. The dual Primary Election takes place on June 18th. Here in Prince William County, we have a primary election for the two open seats in the US Congress - in VA Congressional District 10 and VA Congressional District 7. On the eastern end of the county, we will be voting in the 7th District congressional primary. For those of you that participated in early voting, thank you. I encourage those of you that have not voted, to vote on June 18th (Primary Election Day). You will vote at your assigned polling place. The polls are open from 6 a.m. to 7 p.m., and as long as you are in line by 7pm you will be able to vote. BE A VOTER! Whoever you decide to vote for, I hope you make a plan to vote in the June 18th Primary. If you are not a registered voter, you may do same day registration on Election Day and vote using a provisional ballot. You can view the democratic and republican ballots here [https://www.elections.virginia.gov/casting-a-ballot/candidate-list/] .
Special Session Called for Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Education Program
A special session has been called for both the Virginia State Senate and the House of Delegates to return to Richmond in coming weeks and solve some of the changes made to the Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Program (VMSDEP) in the 2024-2026 budget. The Senate will reconvene on June 18th to consider SB6006 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?242+sum+SB6006] which would clarify that all students who enroll in classes by Fall 2024 are grandfathered into the existing program prior to the budget changes. The Senate’s legislation would also exempt Gold Star Families, applicable Line of Duty beneficiaries, and those wounded as a result of military combat who are at least 90% disabled. The House of Delegates is set to reconvene on June 28th, and our bill can be found at this link [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?242+sum+HB6003] . Both the governor and key members of appropriations committees have declared interest in holding back these substantial changes to the VMSDEP program until more thorough study has been done about policy options.
VFW Recognition for Claim Sharks Bill
I was proud to be recognized at the 102nd annual convention of the Department of Virginia Veterans of Foreign Wars of the United States this past week for my work on HB736, the Veterans Services Protection Act, a bill which seeks to protect veterans from predatory claim sharks who take advantage of them by making false claims and promising benefits while taking huge sums from those who qualify for federal funds. Below are a few details about the bill which highlight why I am so excited to see it enacted on July 1st.
In 2022, President Biden signed the PACT Act [https://www.va.gov/disability/eligibility/hazardous-materials-exposure/specific-environmental-hazards/] into law. The Act greatly expanded [https://virginiamercury.com/2023/08/07/veterans-exposed-to-burn-pits-toxins-urged-to-apply-for-retroactive-benefits/] the number of veterans who could claim benefits from the US Department of Veterans Affairs. Specifically, it provided for veterans who were exposed to toxic chemicals and other environmental hazards to seek care and coverage. While the Act represented a big win for veterans and their families, it also increased the number of predatory individuals eager to take advantage of veterans seeking help.
Because these individuals and organizations are not accredited by the Virginia Department of Veterans Services or US Department of Veterans Affairs, they aren’t required to follow any of the established professional and ethical standards by the VA or abide by guardrails like background checks and continuing education requirements required of accredited claims support businesses.These non-accredited businesses take advantage of veterans by giving misleading, incorrect, and fraudulent advice in pursuit of a higher profit at all costs. These business practices have wide ranging impacts, from impeding veterans’ ability to get the benefits they deserve to causing serious economic harm to the veterans they claim to serve.
As someone who represents a community in Prince William County where 1 in 5 residents identify as a veteran, my bill convenes a work group to study how the General Assembly can develop effective legislation to stop these individuals and organizations from preying on our veterans. HB736 passed the House of Delegates and the Senate with overwhelming bipartisan support and was signed by the governor. It will go into effect on July 1, 2024. I am proud to serve on the working group that will be convened. As the daughter of two Air Force veterans, this issue is extremely personal. It is our duty to look out for the men and women who looked out for us, and that means standing up for our veterans, protecting them from exploitation, and ensuring their access to high-quality support, resources, and care.
“When veterans come home from military service, they need to know that the benefits they earned for serving their country will not make them the target of a new enemy. Predatory companies operating outside of current federal rules governing people and companies who prepare claims for these benefits must be stopped. The Veterans of Foreign Wars is proud to support Delegate Sewell's bipartisan bill, HB736, which will force these Claim Sharks to follow the already existing federal regulations and ensure that veterans and their families are safe in the Commonwealth.” [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/WisemanKenCOAVAwithcover300.jpg]
Ken Wiseman
Past State Commander
VFW Department of Virginia

Prince William Solid Waste Management | Solid Waste Management is the division of Public Works responsible for operation of the landfill, trash disposal, recycling, composting, household hazardous waste collection, and environmental controls to safeguard the community. Below learn a little more about trash and waste in PWC and get answers to your frequently asked questions.
Fees | Residents bringing regular household trash, recyclable materials and yard waste to disposal facilities free of charge, while certain city and town municipalities, waste haulers and commercial users will be assessed a fee. The Solid Waste Disposal Fee funds trash disposal, composting and recycling operations, as well as repays the debt incurred to purchase land to expand the landfill. The Board implemented the fee on January 1, 1999. The Solid Waste Fee appears as a separate line item on the real estate property tax bill and is based on the type of dwelling or business. This includes but is not limited to, decking, lumber or wood, wooden crates, carpet, vinyl flooring or aluminum siding, wire, sheetrock or drywall, glass, pipes, shingles, and other roofing material, and empty containers that have contained construction material. Learn more here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/solid-waste-management/yard-waste-faqs] .
Apartments Trash and Recycling | The owners of apartments and condominium properties are required to establish a recycling system for the separation, collection, handling, storage, and transportation of newspapers, cardboard, mixed paper, #1 and #2 plastic bottles, jugs and jars, and metal food and beverage cans (aluminum, steel, tin, etc.). The property owner should notify tenants and employees within ten days of moving in about trash and recycling policies. Learn more here [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/solid-waste-management/yard-waste-faqs] .

The dual Primary Election takes place on June 18th. Here in Prince William County, we have a primary election for the two open seats in the US Congress - in VA Congressional District 10 and VA Congressional District 7. On the eastern end of the county, we will be voting in the 7th District congressional primary. For those of you that participated in early voting, thank you. I encourage those of you that have not voted, to vote on June 18th (Primary Election Day). You will vote at your assigned polling place. The polls are open from 6 a.m. to 7 p.m., and as long as you are in line by 7pm you will be able to vote. BE A VOTER! Whoever you decide to vote for, I hope you make a plan to vote in the June 18th Primary. If you are not a registered voter, you may do same day registration on Election Day and vote using a provisional ballot. You can view the democratic and republican ballots here [] . Special Session Called for Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Education Program A special session has been called for both the Virginia State Senate and the House of Delegates to return to Richmond in coming weeks and solve some of the changes made to the Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Program (VMSDEP) in the 2024-2026 budget. The Senate will reconvene on June 18th to consider SB6006 [] which would clarify that all students who enroll in classes by Fall 2024 are grandfathered into the existing program prior to the budget changes. The Senate’s legislation would also exempt Gold Star Families, applicable Line of Duty beneficiaries, and those wounded as a result of military combat who are at least 90% disabled. The House of Delegates is set to reconvene on June 28th, and our bill can be found at this link [] . Both the governor and key members of appropriations committees have declared interest in holding back these substantial changes to the VMSDEP program until more thorough study has been done about policy options. VFW Recognition for Claim Sharks Bill I was proud to be recognized at the 102nd annual convention of the Department of Virginia Veterans of Foreign Wars of the United States this past week for my work on HB736, the Veterans Services Protection Act, a bill which seeks to protect veterans from predatory claim sharks who take advantage of them by making false claims and promising benefits while taking huge sums from those who qualify for federal funds. Below are a few details about the bill which highlight why I am so excited to see it enacted on July 1st. In 2022, President Biden signed the PACT Act [] into law. The Act greatly expanded [] the number of veterans who could claim benefits from the US Department of Veterans Affairs. Specifically, it provided for veterans who were exposed to toxic chemicals and other environmental hazards to seek care and coverage. While the Act represented a big win for veterans and their families, it also increased the number of predatory individuals eager to take advantage of veterans seeking help. Because these individuals and organizations are not accredited by the Virginia Department of Veterans Services or US Department of Veterans Affairs, they aren’t required to follow any of the established professional and ethical standards by the VA or abide by guardrails like background checks and continuing education requirements required of accredited claims support businesses.These non-accredited businesses take advantage of veterans by giving misleading, incorrect, and fraudulent advice in pursuit of a higher profit at all costs. These business practices have wide ranging impacts, from impeding veterans’ ability to get the benefits they deserve to causing serious economic harm to the veterans they claim to serve. As someone who represents a community in Prince William County where 1 in 5 residents identify as a veteran, my bill convenes a work group to study how the General Assembly can develop effective legislation to stop these individuals and organizations from preying on our veterans. HB736 passed the House of Delegates and the Senate with overwhelming bipartisan support and was signed by the governor. It will go into effect on July 1, 2024. I am proud to serve on the working group that will be convened. As the daughter of two Air Force veterans, this issue is extremely personal. It is our duty to look out for the men and women who looked out for us, and that means standing up for our veterans, protecting them from exploitation, and ensuring their access to high-quality support, resources, and care. “When veterans come home from military service, they need to know that the benefits they earned for serving their country will not make them the target of a new enemy. Predatory companies operating outside of current federal rules governing people and companies who prepare claims for these benefits must be stopped. The Veterans of Foreign Wars is proud to support Delegate Sewell's bipartisan bill, HB736, which will force these Claim Sharks to follow the already existing federal regulations and ensure that veterans and their families are safe in the Commonwealth.” [] Ken Wiseman Past State Commander VFW Department of Virginia News You Can Use Virginia House speaker OK with special session to restore military tuition program [] | Virginia Mercury Virginia House of Delegates Speaker Don Scott, D-Portsmouth, said he’s not opposed to reconvening the General Assembly to address a public outcry over recent changes to a state program that covers higher education costs for some military families. The state budget approved by Virginia lawmakers in May included some controversial revisions and programmatic cuts to the Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Education Program — which have sparked an outcry from the community, particularly from veteran families. Virginia lawmakers to hold special session on changes to military education benefits program [] | ABC News The Virginia Senate will reconvene in a special legislative session next week to consider a proposal that would exempt some military families from pending changes in eligibility for a state program for educational benefits at state public colleges and universities. New Virginia laws go into effect on July 1 [] | Fox5 Starting July 1, 2024, several new laws will be implemented in Virginia. The laws primarily focus on procedural adjustments rather than significant substantive changes. * Allowing states to ban employers from providing health benefits that cover abortion care.

* Further lowering taxes on big corporations.

* Threatening Medicaid coverage for hundreds of thousands of Americans.

* Reversing the Biden administration’s student debt relief efforts.

* Making the federal government establish marriage between a man and a woman as the “ideal, natural family structure.”

* Ceasing support for international organizations that promote LGBTQ+ equality.

* Allowing Trump to deploy the military against American citizens.

body:

---
Today also marks 2 weeks until the deadline to submit 37,000 signatures in Indiana - our other biggest ballot access challenge. **If you can help in Indiana, please let us know!**
---

---
**Our other most critical need is raising money to pay our team of petitioners.** We’re working with a group of powerhouse community organizers who are going all out to help get the signatures we need. They’re rooted in communities that have been thrown under the bus by the parties of war and Wall Street, where systemic racism has hit hardest and people struggle to afford rent, groceries, healthcare, and other basic needs. These community organizers are exactly the kind of changemakers who we want to partner with - but we _urgently_ need to raise the money to compensate them for their petitioning work. **Please pitch in whatever you can now to make sure we can pay our team to keep Jill on track for ballot access in every state!**
---

---
One more thing - since we’ve passed the threshold to qualify for federal public matching funds, _every single person who donates will get their contribution matched up to the first $250._ That means a $5 donation is basically doubled to $10, $100 becomes $200, and your $250 donation is worth a whopping $500 to our campaign! We hope to receive our first matching funds check soon, but **we urgently need donations right now to fund our critical ballot drives with fast-approaching deadlines. Please pitch in anything you can today and get your contribution supercharged by matching funds!**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_1_week_left&n=6 "GET YOUR DONATION TO JILL MATCHED") [GET YOUR DONATION TO JILL MATCHED](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=il_ba_1_week_left&n=6)

**This is it.** We need your support _now_ if you want voters in every state to have the choice to vote against endless war and genocide; for housing, healthcare, and education as human rights; for real climate action with a Green New Deal; and for all the other causes we're fighting for that the parties of war and Wall Street have been blocking for too long. **What happens in the next 7 days will determine whether Jill will stay on track to be on the ballot across the country - or not.** After how far we've come, _we can't fall short now_. **Please step up. We can do this together!** Thank you for everything you do to power this historic challenge to empire, oligarchy, and genocide! **In solidarity and gratitude,** Team Jill Stein 2024

| Peter,

The month of June marks National Gun Violence Awareness. Right now, our country is facing a gun violence epidemic, and we need to enact significant reforms to stop this epidemic and put an end to mass shootings.

I’ve proudly supported common sense gun safety reform during my time in Congress to promote responsible gun ownership and keep guns out of the hands of dangerous individuals. I proudly support re-enacting the Assault Weapons Ban, and I voted to pass the bipartisan Safer Communities Act that was signed into law.

I know there’s more we can do to keep our communities safe, but with Republicans in control of the House, we are at a standstill on gun safety reform. My district could determine control of the House this November, so I need your support.

**My opponent is beholden to the NRA lobby, and just last year, he voted against background checks to purchase firearms. He also voted to allow individuals to carry firearms without a permit in Pennsylvania – endangering the lives of everyday people and law enforcement.**

Right now, our country is facing a gun violence epidemic, and we need to enact significant reforms to stop this epidemic and put an end to mass shootings. I’ve proudly supported common sense gun safety reform during my time in Congress to promote responsible gun ownership and keep guns out of the hands of dangerous individuals. I proudly support re-enacting the Assault Weapons Ban, and I voted to pass the bipartisan Safer Communities Act that was signed into law. I know there’s more we can do to keep our communities safe, but with Republicans in control of the House, we are at a standstill on gun safety reform. My district could determine control of the House this November, so I need your support. My opponent is beholden to the NRA lobby, and just last year, he voted against background checks to purchase firearms. body:
#
So many PXP friends were in town for the convention that Amy and I decided to have them over to the house.
Over our favorite queso (Vista Market) and cold beer (as cold as we could get it, considering it was over 100-degrees outside) we got a chance to catch up with friends and volunteers that we haven’t seen in a long time.
While we’ve got a lot of hard work ahead, it was fun to just relax, recharge and refuel.
Thanks to everyone who came by, and for those who missed the gathering we’ll do it again before too long.
And thank you for funding our work, supporting these great people and making sure that we have a fighting chance to take Texas back!

It shouldn’t be a surprise that Clinton sided with the war machine while

Fellow American,

I can't tell you how much it means to me that you opened this. Did you know that only about 20-30% of folks open these messages from me?

I do have to ask a quick favor of you - I'm simply asking you to read this all the way through. If you finish reading this and you still think a $1 donation doesn't matter, then I want to just say [**thank you for hearing me out.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3218ceeeb62e4217b80b6e049707cce1&_e=1tYagevj2c6VEKbRpUA4E4TVM_KHDvlzWSczHp2tLHu1p61j5AThz0I3Eg1rpnufgzVd6Xcooem-rCYOQl61WTqQVily13lU-p9CDGsxIb5Panva514PHy-IOE1Mg5PcU3zrdfiujX7AARmP7usywtTIAN-zT6Xr0-8VbSc8YsMtvvjTdCHwYLmavJ4X7UaOdewoDcgfOtUSsO35ETKTgVcSC8K-B3ftt9F7oh6ejeg1hvF-AJ0jux67kXl00BkveK_o-Hktir5jmTl5comHK5bQL5grtG6WkedajYbwiNrHsGfAtSkLCGlRylovGfjnN-0xjxpSRN9PmOT3Iw_JvlQHNP1D2kafNqVyWCsn6vXzP1JcXdG91fwhuz5zlyNagvE8-kxW9A8XrUJ60EJfRG9Cuh5CV5k1o5x-jDz98PNhr1EW60pKgwHnHI3tkowZatwLvF3x_Et2_bA9Zpw4DPH5MUI5N6EUmBORAYDLU-mC3QXcL5MxFHorONEJilC9)

While only about 25% of our friends are opening messages from me and my team, [**only about 1%**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3218ceeeb62e4217b80b6e049707cce1&_e=1tYagevj2c6VEKbRpUA4E4TVM_KHDvlzWSczHp2tLHu1p61j5AThz0I3Eg1rpnufgzVd6Xcooem-rCYOQl61WTqQVily13lU-p9CDGsxIb5Panva514PHy-IOE1Mg5PcU3zrdfiujX7AARmP7usywtTIAN-zT6Xr0-8VbSc8YsMtvvjTdCHwYLmavJ4X7UaOdewoDcgfOtUSsO35ETKTgVcSC8K-B3ftt9F7oh6ejeg1hvF-AJ0jux67kXl00BkveK_o-Hktir5jmTl5comHK5bQL5grtG6WkedajYbwiNrHsGfAtSkLCGlRylovGfjnN-0xjxpSRN9PmOT3Iw_JvjiBJ1ysaZ6nHVkKws2PHi3mT35ouWLlxt1E0xUIkVAwnqkFqyYDqchGhozSF2aFS6wfnYXrhMw5bdDcj-WOSdg8YKr-dsec0VzMUiUS5oogH7RE0KkvJwBfxmkEEIy6_GWkcBK0zGbeMgM4K3OMGH63M4Ersq6zu-fVt0tRpAFZ) will go the extra mile by donating! I'm not exaggerating when I say this, Fellow American, conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with supporters like you.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires that I can call on to hit these goals. [**I rely on the couple of bucks that hard -working Americans receiving these messages can afford to give me from time to time.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3218ceeeb62e4217b80b6e049707cce1&_e=1tYagevj2c6VEKbRpUA4E4TVM_KHDvlzWSczHp2tLHu1p61j5AThz0I3Eg1rpnufgzVd6Xcooem-rCYOQl61WTqQVily13lU-p9CDGsxIb5Panva514PHy-IOE1Mg5PcU3zrdfiujX7AARmP7usywtTIAN-zT6Xr0-8VbSc8YsMtvvjTdCHwYLmavJ4X7UaOdewoDcgfOtUSsO35ETKTgVcSC8K-B3ftt9F7oh6ejeg1hvF-AJ0jux67kXl00BkveK_o-Hktir5jmTl5comHK5bQL5grtG6WkedajYbwiNrHsGfAtSkLCGlRylovGfjnN-0xjxpSRN9PmOT3Iw_JvlCcYvmbrLFaFjh0Qw-HJwW8VQlJDTyclZbEES9GK0gr02gb2ewCd0BubZCI6Hc1xbCoQONn-eq6lzGXQPyfHQRdBQRtRkItgRK5lEmgp0SN3YG0ZXsOgNroxS343roxxZFhFe4CdtwdT_K39kq3_5iXLNLIGwrjkt30OkoARumr)

If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit - even just $1 - we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' _MASSIVE_ campaign coffers.

[**I'll be honest...**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=3218ceeeb62e4217b80b6e049707cce1&_e=1tYagevj2c6VEKbRpUA4E4TVM_KHDvlzWSczHp2tLHu1p61j5AThz0I3Eg1rpnufgzVd6Xcooem-rCYOQl61WTqQVily13lU-p9CDGsxIb5Panva514PHy-IOE1Mg5PcU3zrdfiujX7AARmP7usywtTIAN-zT6Xr0-8VbSc8YsMtvvjTdCHwYLmavJ4X7UaOdewoDcgfOtUSsO35ETKTgVcSC8K-B3ftt9F7oh6ejeg1hvF-AJ0jux67kXl00BkveK_o-Hktir5jmTl5comHK5bQL5grtG6WkedajYbwiNrHsGfAtSkLCGlRylovGfjnN-0xjxpSRN9PmOT3Iw_JvgQ77bCev11nXf0Mlgs-YD-6CKud2GN1rkxqectltMznawCL2GQr1HeOUxh4_bm4ny8RFybGY1YXGk5VcHC-jJkQtgBYopOWQCEhtkVLS8QTlwT3p6cpiPvp-ptChyzqoLc2HlfiEvCKBR-nCx-cG8_htJ_RMfSctCjhw53_VRLk)
The Democrats were able to stop our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit of support we can get if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today. If we're going to stay on pace to reach all of our goals, I truly need your help.

body:

| | | | | [ ](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fourtenn.org%2F/1/010f0190280d80f0-507684f4-359a-4410-9fea-38f95162bce7-000000/vb-dxlGVcOacD8wHy2JAVT8jTt4=163)
---
Hello Peter,
---
| | You may already know Rep. Justin Jones' story: the elected Rep. Jones was expelled, censured, silenced on the House floor, removed from committees, and then the Republicans tried to kick him off the ballot.

That was just his first term. **More is sure to come** \- your donation helps us support him through these MAGA attacks.
---
| [Donate](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_12_Rep_Justin_Jones/1/010f0190280d80f0-507684f4-359a-4410-9fea-38f95162bce7-000000/YKV21eqJ3M1U8Y4YAng4anGhiVc=163 "Donate")
---
We have his back so he can keep on leading. Representative Justin Jones is an amazing leader - someone to be proud of supporting. His activism to curtail gun violence, protect women’s reproductive rights and his involvement in protests against racial injustice have helped make him a leader and vocal advocate for civil rights, environmental issues, and education reform within the state legislature.

But he can’t do it alone. That’s why we are here. To make sure that leaders like Rep. Jones can, well, keep on leading.

How will we help? By funding voter registration drives, turnout, and persuasion ads that help get the message out to the right audiences.

But we cannot do it alone. Can you help us with a small donation of $20 or whatever you can afford?
---
| [Donate](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_12_Rep_Justin_Jones/2/010f0190280d80f0-507684f4-359a-4410-9fea-38f95162bce7-000000/BeZYV6bjXDhDWpgPCO8cGP-gkr4=163 "Donate")
---
Every dollar matters. Because leaders like Rep. Justin Jones can’t do it alone.
---
In solidarity,
Chris Murdock
Our Tennessee Future PAC Team
---
_Our Tennessee Future PAC has been established as a proactive response to the political landscape in Tennessee, which has been taken over by MAGA ideologies. This PAC is dedicated to supporting state-elected officials who represent alternative, more progressive values contrary to those of the MAGA Republicans who currently dominate the state legislature. Key strategies include voter registration drives and targeted advertising campaigns, especially in districts where MAGA-aligned candidates are entrenched or pose a strong threat in upcoming elections. By mobilizing pro-Democratic voters and enhancing electoral participation, Our Tennessee Future PAC aims to effect substantial change and balance within Tennessee's political sphere, ensuring the state's policies and leadership accurately reflect the diverse perspectives of its residents. Your donation helps us in this fight.___

Friend,
Last week, I joined my Democratic colleagues in the Senate to pass a bill that would protect access to IVF (in vitro fertilization).
But Senate Republicans blocked it in a 48-47 vote.
Everyone should be able to access IVF — regardless of what state they live in. This bill would help protect fundamental reproductive rights.
It's simple: I believe everyone should have the freedom to start a family on their own terms, Senate Republicans do not.
We won’t be able to make progress in the fight for reproductive rights without more pro-choice votes in the Senate. This is too important to wait — which is why I’m writing you this email.

subject: Will you help my friend + fellow PA Senator Bob Casey?

body:
Bob’s opponent just spoke at an event hosted by Moms for Liberty, the far-right activist group that’s behind all the censorship happening in school libraries.
#
Hey Derek, it's John.
I’m reaching out about my friend + fellow PA Senator Bob Casey. He’s up for re-election this year and it’s looking like it’s going to be a pretty close race.
Bob’s GOP opponent, Dave McCormick, has been trying to distance himself from MAGA politicians like Trump, hoping it’ll help his chances here in PA.
**But get this: He just spoke at an event hosted by Moms for Liberty** , the far-right activist group that’s behind all the censorship happening in school libraries. And he was joined by none other than **Betsy DeVos** , Trump’s Secretary of Education.
McCormick’s not fooling anyone, Derek. He’s just as bad as the rest of those MAGA guys, and he’ll vote in lockstep with them in the Senate if he gets the chance.
That’s why it’s so important that we re-elect Bob this year. And with the end of the fundraising quarter approaching, I’m hoping you can help.
[**Derek, will you pitch in $5 to be split evenly between my campaign and Bob’s? We’ll split your donation automatically, and it’ll make a world of difference.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240617?refcode=em20240617&amount=5&refcode2=9125_434096_UC_65V&akid=9125%2E434096%2EUC_65V)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240617?amount=5&refcode=em20240617-9125&refcode2=9125_434096_UC_65V&akid=9125%2E434096%2EUC_65V)**
Thanks,
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator, Pennsylvania

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Ted Cruz can’t be trusted to protect our freedom
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
When it comes to the Texas Senate race, my friend Colin Allred is the only candidate we can count on to protect our freedom.
That’s why today I’m asking you to split a contribution between Colin’s campaign and mine. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240617split_ca?refcode=lpfe240617split_ca]
Last week, I met with fellow Texan Lauren Miller, who was in Washington to testify before the Senate Judiciary Committee about her experience arising from Texas’ abortion ban. A plaintiff in the Zurawski v. State of Texas case challenging the Texas abortion ban, Lauren was hospitalized and diagnosed with a condition posing significant risks to her and her pregnancy, later learning that one of her twins had a condition that was threatening her other twin and her own life. But she couldn’t get the medical care she needed in Texas. Lauren has shared her story in the hope of making real policy change, and Colin and I met with her to hear about her experience and how we can help Texas women.
The Senate Judiciary Committee heard from her, too. That was the purpose of her trip. But not all of them showed up. Including her own senator. Senator Cruz, a senior member of the committee, skipped the hearing.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240617split_ca?refcode=lpfe240617split_ca [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240617split_ca?refcode=lpfe240617split_ca]
It is clear: We can’t trust Cruz to do the right thing when it comes to protecting access to reproductive health care or freedom. He doesn’t even listen to Texas women when they testify in his Senate committee about their experiences. We know he is not listening anywhere else.
We can’t forget that Cruz introduced an extreme federal abortion ban, or he has supported the same kind of “personhood” legislation that drove Alabama’s IVF ruling. We can’t be fooled by his purported effort to protect IVF, which leaves the door wide open for states to target certain aspects of the IVF process and doesn’t do anything to protect IVF providers from prosecution. We know that when a bill that would actually codify IVF protections came before the Senate, Cruz and Senate Republicans blocked it. And, of course, Cruz supported overturning Roe v. Wade , which has fast-tracked these efforts to take away our freedom. We can trust that Senator Cruz will continue to restrict our freedom to make our own decisions.
In contrast, we can trust Colin to listen to us, to stand up for us, and fight back for us. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240617split_ca?refcode=lpfe240617split_ca]
Needless to say, Cruz can’t be trusted to protect reproductive freedom. He can’t even be counted on to show up and listen.
We deserve better. And we can have it. If we elect Colin Allred. He and I will be working from now to November to make sure he is representing Texas next year in the Senate. To help us, will you split a contribution between Colin’s campaign and mine here? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240617split_ca?refcode=lpfe240617split_ca]
There is a lot we need to do in Texas to turn things around. This year, one thing we can do is get a new Senator. And I am going to do all I can to make it happen. I hope you will, too.
Together, we can do anything,

clean_body: ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [] When it comes to the Texas Senate race, my friend Colin Allred is the only candidate we can count on to protect our freedom. That’s why today I’m asking you to split a contribution between Colin’s campaign and mine. [] Last week, I met with fellow Texan Lauren Miller, who was in Washington to testify before the Senate Judiciary Committee about her experience arising from Texas’ abortion ban. A plaintiff in the Zurawski v. State of Texas case challenging the Texas abortion ban, Lauren was hospitalized and diagnosed with a condition posing significant risks to her and her pregnancy, later learning that one of her twins had a condition that was threatening her other twin and her own life. But she couldn’t get the medical care she needed in Texas. Lauren has shared her story in the hope of making real policy change, and Colin and I met with her to hear about her experience and how we can help Texas women. The Senate Judiciary Committee heard from her, too. That was the purpose of her trip. But not all of them showed up. Including her own senator. Senator Cruz, a senior member of the committee, skipped the hearing. [] It is clear: We can’t trust Cruz to do the right thing when it comes to protecting access to reproductive health care or freedom. He doesn’t even listen to Texas women when they testify in his Senate committee about their experiences. We know he is not listening anywhere else. We can’t forget that Cruz introduced an extreme federal abortion ban, or he has supported the same kind of “personhood” legislation that drove Alabama’s IVF ruling. We can’t be fooled by his purported effort to protect IVF, which leaves the door wide open for states to target certain aspects of the IVF process and doesn’t do anything to protect IVF providers from prosecution. We know that when a bill that would actually codify IVF protections came before the Senate, Cruz and Senate Republicans blocked it. And, of course, Cruz supported overturning Roe v. Wade , which has fast-tracked these efforts to take away our freedom. We can trust that Senator Cruz will continue to restrict our freedom to make our own decisions. In contrast, we can trust Colin to listen to us, to stand up for us, and fight back for us. [] Needless to say, Cruz can’t be trusted to protect reproductive freedom. He can’t even be counted on to show up and listen. We deserve better. And we can have it. If we elect Colin Allred. He and I will be working from now to November to make sure he is representing Texas next year in the Senate. To help us, will you split a contribution between Colin’s campaign and mine here? [] There is a lot we need to do in Texas to turn things around. This year, one thing we can do is get a new Senator. And I am going to do all I can to make it happen. I hope you will, too. Convention recap and Signature gathering!

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_statewide_call_remind&n=1)
