Monday, June 17, 2024 |
### Tired of the Same Old things in politics?
Peter -- Join us Tonight, June 17th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u6P9-Hx0zs-QPm6VAaSuDh4Sdlc62t3OcWCnrBmB7tVtdrPWWqIK2Jr5L7IDADtVNA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_statewide_call_remind&n=2) This is the time when all the work comes together. For 2 years, we've all been getting on calls, attending events, and supporting building a new party in PA. Now is the time to lean in and make it happen. We have candidates in races. We have systems to support those candidates. We have relationships to support us. We just need the core group of volunteers to make it all happen. The most urgent thing we've ever asked is for you to help us gather signatures. If everyone who received this email signed petition themselves, we'd be way over the signature goal. We know it's intimidating to ask people to sign a petition but if you're willing to print out a sheet, get your family and friends to sign it and mail it in, please reply to this email and we'll get you what you need. This is something real you can do to make a difference and build something new.
* * *
### Convention Recap
Thank you to everyone that made the convention such a success. We'll be talking about the highlights and the business that was done. Check out the youtube page to see videos of the event. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEpfPMB7uVBZkK7A1O5VOawVgzNtc2GhXIbWIDDZpgIuF&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_statewide_call_remind&n=3 "PA Forward Youtube") [PA Forward Youtube](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEpfPMB7uVBZkK7A1O5VOawVgzNtc2GhXIbWIDDZpgIuF&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_statewide_call_remind&n=3)
---
### State Chair Election
We also want to celebrate the reelection of our State Chair Christian Fyke at the convention. Christian is responsible for so much of the growth and stability since the beginning. Both in a front facing role and behind the scenes we're incredibly happy that he will remain in his current position for another term.

name: Team McBride
subject: This is just the beginning…
body:
We wanted to make sure you didn't miss this.
#
Did you catch Sarah's email yesterday?
Marjorie Taylor Greene has given us a taste of what Sarah will have to endure from the MAGA GOP and alt-right now as we race toward Election Day – and we know these attacks will only escalate.
Make no mistake: **Sarah is running for Congress to bring her results-driven approach to DC for the good of every Delawarean** , NOT to pick fights with MAGA Republicans who are more focused on personal attacks and manufactured culture wars.
But MAGA extremists are targeting Sarah because she would make history as the first openly trans member of Congress. **We need to stand with Sarah and help her fight back in the weeks and months to come.**
[**Will you help defend Sarah McBride from the MAGA GOP’s hateful attacks by making a $5 contribution to her campaign right now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240617-1?refcode=em20240617-1-642&amount=5&refcode2=642_21716_wsv4nG&akid=642%2E21716%2Ewsv4nG)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240617-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240617-1-642&refcode2=642_21716_wsv4nG&akid=642%2E21716%2Ewsv4nG)**
If you missed Sarah’s email yesterday, continue reading below.
Yesterday on Steve Bannon’s talk show, **Marjorie Taylor Greene described me and my candidacy as a “complete evil” that will “curse” our nation.** Not because of my policy agenda. Simply because of who I am.
Believe me, I am no stranger to these kinds of attacks from the MAGA extremists. I expected this from MTG and, believe me, **I won't lose sleep over what she thinks of me.**
If there’s one thing I know for sure, it’s this: I’m not running for Congress to pick fights with MAGA Republicans who want to waste the American people’s time on personal attacks and manufactured culture wars. I am running because I have a record of getting things done for Delaware — and Congress desperately needs more people who are there for the right reasons, rather than politicians stoking flames of fear and hate. **We need serious legislators in Congress, not professional provocateurs.**
I’m running to bring my results-driven approach to Washington so we can make progress on the most important issues: affordable health care and housing, paid leave and childcare, gun reform, solutions to the climate crisis, and so much more. That’s what this campaign is all about — and we’re not going to get distracted by the people who want to divide our country with their agenda of hatred.
These attacks won’t stop me from fighting for you. And even extremists like Marjorie Taylor Greene won’t stop me from bringing people together to deliver for all of us just like I’ve done in Delaware. I’m heartened that Delaware Democrats are united behind this campaign in the face of these attacks.
[**If you’re with me in this fight, can you make a $5 contribution right now to help send me to Congress? Together, we are stronger than any of the attacks.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240617-1?refcode=em20240617-1-642&amount=5&refcode2=642_21716_wsv4nG&akid=642%2E21716%2Ewsv4nG)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240617-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240617-1-642&refcode2=642_21716_wsv4nG&akid=642%2E21716%2Ewsv4nG)**
Thank you, as always, for your love and support.
Sarah McBride
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20240617-1&t=1&refcode2=642_21716_wsv4nG&akid=642%2E21716%2Ewsv4nG)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/receive_fewer_emails/?t=2&akid=642%2E21716%2Ewsv4nG)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/update_your_information/?t=3&akid=642%2E21716%2Ewsv4nG)

As I’ve talked about before, my family immigrated to America from Ireland. When I started school in Arizona, just before my 5th birthday, I still had an Irish accent. I kept that accent until my first-grade teacher worried I had a speech impediment and called for an emergency parent-teacher conference. Once she heard my parents speak, she realized it wasn’t a speech impediment, just an Irish accent.
My wife Tina had a similar immigrant experience. Her family fled Iran during that country’s revolution, and while she didn’t have an Irish accent, she was called a “terrorist” by her classmates. Both of our families came to the U.S. to seek out the American dream.
Now Tina and I are raising our three beautiful children in the same city and same school district where I grew up. But life was better here 30 years ago: Women had the right to have an abortion, we had an assault weapons ban, and fighting climate change was cool. But we have gone backwards thanks to MAGA extremists like David Schweikert.
[The support I’ve received in just the past few weeks is overwhelming (in a good way!) From being endorsed by Stonewall Democrats to the Penjamo Yaqui Pueblo Board of Directors, I couldn’t be more grateful. But I need to keep up the momentum, and that’s where I need your help. Fair, efficient, and simple are words you probably don't associate with our tax system. But what if they could be?

Unfortunately, the federal income tax is a complete mess.

It's not efficient, fair, or simple. It fosters tax avoidance and cheating and costs billions of dollars to administer. First proposed in 1981 by Hoover fellows Alvin Rabushka and Robert Hall, the flat tax was intended to simplify the federal tax system by replacing the progressive federal income tax system with a low and simple flat tax. They believed that the flat tax was the fairest, most efficient, simplest, and most workable tax plan.

The flat tax plan would give an enormous boost to the US economy by dramatically improving incentives to work, save, invest, and take entrepreneurial risks. It would also save taxpayers hundreds of billions in direct and indirect costs.

As we navigate the complexities of our present tax system, it becomes evident that change is necessary. The classic book, _The Flat Tax_ , critiques the flaws in our highly progressive tax structure and introduces a practical, efficient, and workable alternative.

Hall and Rabushka explain that:
* All income should be taxed once, and only once, at a uniform low rate.
* A flat tax would eliminate the distortions of the present tax treatment of business.
* It is not an academic abstraction but a workable solution that has been implemented in many countries.
* If meaningful, systematic tax reform is to succeed, it won't be birthed in Washington. It will come from millions of taxpayers demanding fairness in taxation.

That's why we want to share this Hoover Classic with as many Americans as possible, starting with you. By requesting your free copy of _The Flat Tax_ eBook, you not only gain access to invaluable insights but also become part of a community engaged in reshaping our thinking on taxation.

As you delve into the pages of _The Flat Tax_ , you'll discover not only the critique of the current system but a practical alternative that has been a guiding light for those seeking fairness, efficiency, and practicality.

Join us in unlocking the legacy of _The Flat Tax_. Claim your free copy now and become part of a movement for transformative ideas in tax reform. You can get your eBook copy here: [https://resources.hoover.org/the-flat-tax](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=bcb6830783214ea99a2cdc486f2f4196&_e=qyzrXlz9TdfK9y1agqOAArGqqcMLid9RT4XVo1rJWkaZ9SfbhnlO8AOaORPqPDoyyKL1XH7j01GjkgndgUB8tMmE0cMNGS6CtP2Tm3MhUWjnI6Ew3nvdodsxsStfGENtsb4DN0ujjX4aWtHhalK50rjOlg7IqUcbj_FyHkJwDhLqAGoZlJHc2Ms9ziQfetryfjrkiqUuu5ij5kVWk11attVSKO0mxMtSI6xoIigDaWYB-HL-hL1Xl3fPxAzS8q3izYCLgHqXBxjUX9IwDVD02JWF7ioSJ9o1x_wnzcx_sZOQEfra_jWLHcSvzxqrupCdii7nQCwLABDBiA4q9Em9uHs68h1iVjDWBJN16UaU1h0%3D)

| | **Earlier this year, I helped negotiate a bipartisan plan to expand the overwhelmingly successful and popular child tax credit and lift half a million kids out of poverty.** The proposal passed the House by a big margin, and I've been hopeful that we can _finally_ boost the child tax credit for many of the families who saw critical aid expire at the end of 2021. During the pandemic, the child tax credit was a life saving resource for millions of families. It was the poster child for good policy making a real difference in working families' lives. But thanks to a group of hardline Senate Republicans, my bill to renew this lifeline has been collecting dust for over _four months._ While I know almost everything these days gets wrapped up in political divides, I really thought that the one thing we could all agree on is lifting 500,000 kids out of poverty. So why is my bill being delayed? Pure election-year politics. Some Senate Republicans will throw working families under the bus if it means depriving President Biden of a "win." They also are holding out for the possibility that a new GOP Senate come 2025 could help them negotiate a different deal – one that helps them give more tax breaks to billionaires but does nothing for those who need the most help. **Let me be very clear: I'm working to get this bill passed**** _now_****because keeping kids out of poverty shouldn't be subject to the usual D.C. games.** I believe that the government should make a meaningful difference in people's lives. # On the anniversary of Mother Emanuel AME's most horrific day

It was nine years ago today a deranged white supremacist walked into Charleston's Mother Emanuel AME Church. Those gathered there for Bible study did what good Christians are commended to - they welcomed him. Dylann Roof attended their study before inexplicably opening fire on those who welcomed him, killing nine and inuring one, before fleeing the church.
A prior narcotics arrest should have prevented him from being able to buy a gun, but the underfunded bureau charged with overseeing the instant background system failed those victims, as did the ugliness of white supremacy.
This past weekend, high school graduates at Newtown Connecticut observed a moment of silence for the twenty then-first graders whose lives were brutally taken at Sandy Hook Elementary in another senseless act of gun violence in 2012.
Last Friday, the Trump-stacked, radically conservative Supreme Court overturned a law Trump actually backed and signed, eliminating "bump stocks" that turn just about any semiautomatic rifle into a machine gun - as was used to kill sixty and wound hundreds in Las Vegas in 2017.
The Washington Post editorial board [opines](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=f364f8e650&e=5d7e9a146c) this is "what can go wrong when such clearly legislative matters are left up to the bureaucracy and the courts. It would be far preferable for Congress to provide fresh guidance, instead of relying on regulators and judges to parse a 90-year old statutory text."
My question to you is: Do you trust MAGA Republican Russell Fry to do this, with his ["A rating" and endorsement from the radical National Rifle Association](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=f520055e21&e=5d7e9a146c) (NRA)?"
I, on the other hand, prefer to work organizations like "Moms Demand Action," who seek common sense gun laws and reforms to stem the epidemic of gun violence and mass shootings in the United States.
We're just a few seats shy of being able to pass meaningful legislation in the House and Senate. Together, we can work to craft bipartisan common sense gun control.
[Will you help me fire Fry, the NRA guy?](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=f2dc84d08b&e=5d7e9a146c)
---

clean_body: While extreme politicians across the country seek to pass further restrictions on family planning, reproductive healthcare, and contraception, we must make sure that reproductive care remains safe and accessible here in Virginia. | = Peter, Since the Dobbs decision, women in states that have passed strict abortion bans have been forced to travel hours across state lines to receive care. We knew this would happen. Virginia remains one of the last states in the South that hasn’t severely restricted access or enacted a ban since Dobbs , and because of that, women across the South have looked to Virginia for the care they need. While extreme politicians across the country seek to pass further restrictions on family planning, reproductive healthcare, and contraception, we must make sure that reproductive care remains safe and accessible here in Virginia. As Virginia’s next Governor, I will protect our patients and providers – and I will defend the freedom to make our own healthcare decisions.= | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Abigail * | | Paid for by Spanberger for Governor Spanberger for Governor P.O. body:
| | Hi Peter, Did you see my last email? In case you missed it, June is the 118th anniversary of the Antiquities Act, which grants U.S. Presidents with the ability to designate national monuments for federal lands and waters with scientific, historical, and/or cultural significance. The Owyhee Canyonlands needs our protection now, presenting us with one of the country’s single greatest opportunities for conservation in the West. In order to achieve an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument, we need to show our support so our Senators will [join the 73% of Oregonians calling for this protection for the Owyhee.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090015/480003395/-235629718?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=&emci=37921d7c-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2ea33041-f72c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) **[Will you send our Senators a message today?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090016/480003396/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=&emci=37921d7c-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2ea33041-f72c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)** Thank you for joining the movement! Eliza Walton
OLCV Public Lands Manager | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090017/480003397/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=&emci=37921d7c-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2ea33041-f72c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)Hi Peter, The Owyhee Canyonlands is Oregon’s last great unprotected natural treasure, and it deserves protection before it’s too late! [73% of Oregonians (and nearly 50,000 petition signers and hundreds of businesses, organizations, and community groups)](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090018/480003398/835257482?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=&emci=37921d7c-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2ea33041-f72c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) support an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument. With the 118th anniversary of the Antiquities Act coming up on June 8th, now is the perfect time for our Senators to get on board and help us call on President Biden for an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument! [**Will you send the message to Senators Wyden and Merkely today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090019/480003399/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=&emci=37921d7c-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2ea33041-f72c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090020/480003400/-1005412785?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=&emci=37921d7c-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2ea33041-f72c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)What is the Antiquities Act? Thanks to the Antiquities Act, U.S. Presidents have the ability to designate national monuments for federal lands and waters with scientific, historical, and/or cultural significance. This anniversary reminds us of the importance of national monuments for providing more equitable access to nature and strengthening biodiversity and wildlife habitat amidst a rapidly changing climate, and the Owyhee Canyonlands fits the bill. Congress also has the opportunity to permanently protect the Owyhee Canyonlands by passing [Senator Wyden’s Malheur Community Empowerment for the Owyhee Act (S 1890)](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090021/480003402/-1443505139?emci=e272bfc3-969f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=fa4d5fba-38a0-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=1246005&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=), which is also supported by Senator Merkley. Senator Wyden has repeatedly led efforts to protect the Owyhee, but everytime Congress has failed to act. We thank Senators Wyden and Merkley for their leadership, and ask them to join 73% of Oregonians in supporting an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument and ask President Biden to make the designation. Today, only 5% of the Owyhee Canyonlands are protected and the threats of industrial development and climate change are clawing at its edges. 1.1 million acres would be protected from these threats with an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument. The Owyhee Canyonlands represents one of the country’s single greatest opportunities for conservation in the West. **[Email our Senators today to encourage them to work with the Biden Administration to establish an Owyhee Canyonlands National Monument!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090022/480003403/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=&emci=37921d7c-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2ea33041-f72c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)** President Biden has already used the Antiquities Act 10 times during his tenure to expand, designate, or restore national monuments. And the numbers don’t lie: Oregonians want to protect the Owyhee Canyonlands. **[Make the Owyhee Canyonlands the next National Monument by asking for the support of our Senators today!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87090023/480003404/-2140872232?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJlYTMzMDQxLWY3MmMtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5ULlJxN7BULgqsYqvWdjxmX7xgzPOAUZdPIrS8D08_k=&emci=37921d7c-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2ea33041-f72c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)** Sincerely, Eliza Walton

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1547%2E135344%2ErBFKqN)

Friend -
Last week, we shared with you the _Detroit Free Press_ ’s endorsement of our campaign in the Democratic primary.
But they also made a recommendation in the Republican primary, and we want to make sure you see it, because it’s more evidence that the Republican primary for Senate will be messy all the way through the primary election in August.
In a major blow to Trump-endorsed former Congressman Mike Rogers, the _Free Press_ recommended that GOP primary voters select former Representative Justin Amash over Rogers.
Here’s the money quote:
_"Rogers’ transactional approach to politics, his ideological inconsistency and obeisance to former President Donald Trump render him a poor fit for this Senate seat."_
In other words, Michigan’s largest newspaper is calling Rogers out on abandoning his principles and doing anything (and everything) in pursuit of personal power.
They point out that Rogers cultivated a reputation for bipartisanship in Congress and forcefully criticized Donald Trump in 2016 and 2020, particularly around his attempts to overturn the 2020 election.
Not only has he since embraced Donald Trump, a move the _Free Press_ describes as "hardly a profile in courage, and squandering whatever bipartisan bona fides he once claimed," but now refuses to answer on whether Joe Biden won the 2020 election. That alone, the _Free Press_ says, "would render Rogers unfit to serve."
In summary:
_"We detected little consistency among Rogers’ political positions — but had no trouble concluding that the former congressman has learned all too well how to read the political room, a transactional approach to ideology that may well win him the primary._
_But in a U.S. Senator, we’re looking for principles."_
With this notable endorsement for Amash, and Sandy Pensler continuing to spend big on TV attacking Rogers, it’s clear this primary is far from over.
While Republicans fight amongst themselves, we’re implementing a plan aimed at winning the general election in November. We’re hard at work growing our field campaign and meeting voters across the state. We’re also airing TV ads in several media markets introducing Elissa to new voters, and we’ve already heard from a lot of voters who saw it and were excited about Elissa’s message.
[**But our plan to win in November requires us to continually hit fundraising targets so we can _keep_ our ads on TV and expand our grassroots operations. Hi folks,

Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re in the middle of the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country, and we need your help to win.

We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.

**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.

But right now, we’re in the toughest reelection fight of our lives.

**FIRST,** election experts called us the most vulnerable Democratic senators up in 2024.

**THEN,** Mitch McConnell and his cronies said they would spend over a hundred million dollars to try to defeat us.

**NOW,** we’re officially up against two self-funding multimillionaires who are bankrolling their campaigns themselves.

We can’t write our campaigns million dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: You. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers, you name it — who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference.

[Things are really heating up in our races so we’ve set a rapid response Big Sky Buckeye Fund goal to raise $500,000 in the next 48 hours to fight back against the millions being thrown our way. subject: About Donald Trump

body:
| | |
---
Friend, did you see Donald Trump’s interview in TIME Magazine last month?
* He said he would allow states to prosecute and punish women seeking reproductive health care.
* He said he would allow states to invade women’s privacy and _monitor their pregnancies._
* And he wouldn’t rule out signing a national abortion ban or legislation banning IVF.

Donald Trump and extremist Republicans are doing everything they can to take away a woman’s right to decide if, when and how she can have children.
Bodily autonomy and right to privacy are on the ballot this November. **That’s why we _need_ to do everything we can to keep the Senate blue this fall: so we can hold our Democratic majority and defend our reproductive rights. | | **From The Chairman**
---
| | Don’t just take the Pentagon’s [word](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=f29800ac591544b9b7bae0cf5aa70332&_e=b0FJ0u5uOVmZmiHMdHwVFCDDjVBT8OkAgYyUAuvFnLMtLFOnAPhWaJm50oR80OvVTBdYwvLZz0djVa6YqeQ4PA88ZWHjL2_GIN0x9sNfevGuT9cY7Rp3NuAgjl4okQwGACo9_ksCCUjM17E7xhDz9kcdJ_LlfTwTbYFnBI-5Mc1rcb_mRiLVYodGt0exYFSDxJ4ejnDkpMJAIKc_DmTDORLVRXI4mWvoMMeVTZoN2tBvAZpxUUcjEX1CsJh-1tmpyGvBX3YKXS5RQwFLGghidN5F3esDwmtoiSYaB9zdi8gmzb7rZftd_I7c1kUirFXdJvrZ4Eop3IDN9LXNsDkS9A%3D%3D) for it, but China is aggressively modernizing its nuclear arsenal [according](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=f29800ac591544b9b7bae0cf5aa70332&_e=b0FJ0u5uOVmZmiHMdHwVFBVZVlyyHUQwR2NDHPev00UtIXxh6wTQFs3RVKKqv1Lw3IyZhkDglzwYfRyXKUfkqtbpPSjxi_nVdaf7TXcl0tYtbVwiLGBioNCtJmXMuM_WBIs7WGv-cpmq7ODqOpThfpZ3iApI7AzlxDcsiscGIrxmC1-fPveZK7_UzVAE4aer0PNybh_I5gj0VDdeRbwxDz5jjzNFyOROXGuEXHZXhmJuDeHujIW9PG-ryZGIn52DwgOf5SH4x864qKDlAfRB3A%3D%3D) to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI), a group that monitors global security developments. Beijing’s arsenal has grown from 410 in 2023 to 500 warheads in 2024 and could well be on track to have 1,000 by the end of the decade. While a fraction of our nuclear arsenal (which we have consistently underinvested in and is rapidly aging), it is indicative of the Chinese Communist Party’s hegemonic ambitions in the region, and desire to become a greater player in global security. What does it mean for us? It means nuclear deterrence becomes a whole lot more complicated when we are facing off against both Moscow and Beijing. It means our ability to defend our allies and our interests in the Indo-Pacific becomes even more important. It means we need to invest a lot more in modernizing our arsenal, our missile defense, and our early warning capabilities. China wants to unseat us on the global stage and it's time we have leaders in Washington who take both what Beijing says and what it does seriously before we wake up and realize it’s too late.
